Ohio voters deserve to hear from the folks running for governor this year – **and that’s why I’m challenging Mike DeWine to hold a series of debates all across the state.**

Dear Fellow American, A few years ago, _New York_ magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?” This is, of course, an exaggeration. But it makes clear that the far-Left in America aims to bring about a “Great Reset” of our economy and our way of life. In a recent issue of _Imprimis_ —Hillsdale College’s digest of liberty—author Michael Rectenwald described the economic goal of the Great Reset as “‘capitalism with Chinese characteristics’—a two-tiered economy, with profitable monopolies and the state on top and socialism for the majority below.” Today, as a supporter of liberty, you can help Hillsdale College understand the extent of support for—and opposition to—socialism. Your input will help us develop the most effective strategy to fight for the future of liberty in our country. **Will you please share your views on the political, social, and cultural forces promoting socialism in our country by completing your National Survey on Socialism using the secure link below?** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zq7kj1a9k26qheashd1pkigm45665ieotnkh97k0_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s3h69or3c1h2bs)** Sadly, socialism is becoming increasingly popular, especially among the young. You may be aware of a SHOCKING survey showing that... **. . . during the COVID-19 pandemic, support for socialism among those 16 to 23 years old jumped to 49 percent, and socialism also increased in popularity among all ages.** **Why is this?** Draconian government lockdown measures destroyed businesses and eliminated competitors of corporate monopolists. These policies were a dream come true for corporate socialists. At the same time, too many young Americans have not been taught what socialism really means. Or the dismal history of its failures wherever it has been tried. This is a result of the far-Left’s “long march through the institutions”—including colleges and universities, K-12 schools, and the media. Marxist-inspired critical race theory is a prime example. Once confined to the classrooms of far-Left professors, critical race theory has infiltrated every level of government, as well as school boards and even the military. But it is in our schools where the effects of critical race theory—which teaches young Americans to categorize their fellow citizens according to race—are most dangerous. You may recall that many young Americans with college degrees who championed socialist policies participated in the riots and violence we witnessed in the summer of 2020. In the face of well-financed and widespread efforts to destroy free markets and individual liberty, Hillsdale’s work to **reach** and **teach** millions has never been more urgently needed. **That’s why I need your thoughts quickly.** By responding to the **National Survey on Socialism** in the next five days**,** your honest opinions will help us understand the recent rise of socialism and develop our strategy to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. We hope to hear from friends representing every part of the country. Education is the surest way to turn back this dangerous trend. And your partnership with Hillsdale College is critical. As Winston Churchill said, “Socialism is the philosophy of failure, the creed of ignorance, and the gospel of envy.” If you agree, please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Socialism** today. **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zqh1i9llm71k2nof1h2irrjvd1s81n57brr8p0hg_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s3h69or3c1h2bs)** Despite the recent successes of the far-Left, we must remember—**it is NEVER too late to defend liberty through education**. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

name: Team Diehl-Allen
subject: Reminder: Diehl/Allen Volunteer Help this Week
body:
Get Involved Today!
| | | |
---
| All, We are looking for volunteers to help us with the following. We have 5 weeks until the GOP primary election, so now is the time to get involved!
SECURITY: We are looking for volunteers willing to serve as security for Geoff and Leah at events. If this is something which interests you, please contact our security coordinator, Jim McGinn: jim.c.mcginn@gmail.com.
SIGN STANDOUTS: We would like to have a series of sign standouts for visibility across the state. Especially on weekends, when voters are traveling to weekend trips, these visibility events can really promote our candidates. We need individuals willing to step up in their area(promote to others, gather the signs and hand them out, etc.).
If you are willing to lead a sign standout in your community, please contact Annette Benenato at annette@geoffdiehl.com. We will provide you the signs/banners, and help to promote your location.
BALLOT REFERENDUM ON DRIVERS' LICENSES FOR ILLEGAL IMMIGRANTS: The push to get this question on the ballot continues. We need everyone's help! We have 4 more weeks to get the requisite number of signatures. If you support overturning this law, please lend some time. We are looking for individuals to lead ballot collection at their local grocery stores, community events, and at dumps on the weekends. Please let Annette know if you will help to organize a collection effort this week, either weeknights or this weekend, in your area.
GET OUT THE VOTE CALLS FOR GEOFF AND LEAH:
We are asking for individuals to make calls to get out the vote for the GOP primary for Geoff and Leah. If you can assist with this, please contact Deputy Field Director Bridget Hardiman, at bridget@geoffdiehl.com.

body:
Normally about 90% of the hairs on your scalp are in what’s called a “growth phase,” while the other 10% are in a “resting & shedding” phase... But after a stressful event, such as COVID-19 infection, surgery, menopause, or a hormonal imbalance “...**up to 50 PERCENT of hairs are resting and shedding** ,” says Powell Perng, MD, a hair loss specialist at University of Utah Health. Fortunately, [**one distinct type of protein**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64854%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=bPgnza9umhz%2bOlBtsXzYaw&sysid=1) was recently proven to boost hair follicle thickness & help prevent balding... name: Ron DeSantis
subject: Biden has failed the American people
body:
| | | [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60873994:60-5LTVN5:m:1:3253819041:12C6FA3FFB847F60293622059089AB22:r)
---
Peter, The media's lens for viewing the government is broken.

It's broken in a way that makes it easy for the legacy media to call real, rational concern hyperbole. It's broken in a way that makes it easy for the media to normalize failure.

When I tell you Joe Biden is a failed president, the media line up to attack me. But make no mistake, he is a failure.

**He has failed the American people.

_He has failed you._**

He, with help from the corporate media, has gone a step further and normalized that failure. It's so normal they look at you sideways for even noticing it.

I need you to pause here for a second. Think about the messages you get on a daily basis from the Biden administration and from their allies in the media. If you boil them down, you'll hear two steady notes. A drum beat:
1. Everything is going fine.

2. Anything that isn't fine isn't Joe Biden's fault.

One. Two. One. Two.

And they're going to keep beating that drum faster and faster and faster to try and misdirect the American people into supporting Biden apologists for office in 2022.

**That's not a tune I will listen to. That's not a tune you're going to hear in Florida.**

Biden's failure isn't something we made up. It's not a set of talking points. The choices he's made are real, their consequences have been devastating, and the pain felt by Americans across the country is real.

This legacy of failure he's cementing is seeping its way into every crevice of our country.

He presided over out-of-control spending that drove up the price of EVERYTHING and inflated away your purchasing power...

He's bowed to climate extremists and embraced an energy policy that you're paying for every day in higher costs at the pump...

Perhaps his greatest failure has been his total negligence regarding our southern border.

**Over 3 million people have illegally crossed the border since he took office. 3,000,000 people. And Joe Biden has done nothing but facilitate it.**

His failure at the border is killing people. It's creating enormous levels of drug trafficking. For the first time ever, the leading cause of death for people 18-45 in the U.S. is fentanyl overdose. 95% of which is coming from the U.S.-Mexico border.

Those deaths are a direct result of Biden's failure. I refuse to ignore that failure. I refuse to accept it. You should not accept it, either.

The 2022 elections are a line in the sand. **In states like Florida, where we have a slate of Biden apologists running for office, _we cannot give one single inch._**

**Not one.**

That's why I wrote to you today. You know Biden has failed. You see it every time you fill up your car. You see it every time you read the news and see crime spilling onto our streets. You hear it every time your kids or grandkids echo some woke nonsense they heard from some Leftist talking points.

But I need you to do more than just know it. I need you to take action. **_[I need you to make a donation right now.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60873994:60-5LTVN5:m:1:3253819041:12C6FA3FFB847F60293622059089AB22:r "I need you to make a donation right
now.")_**

We're going to work for every single vote, every single mind, every single choice. We're going to ensure that the message that Joe hears on Election Night is crystal-clear:

**Florida isn't Biden Country. America isn't Biden Country.

Failure will not be our legacy.**

**[Please, make a donation right now. Help me deliver that message.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60873994:60-5LTVN5:m:1:3253819041:12C6FA3FFB847F60293622059089AB22:r)**
Sincerely, __

# Vedat Gashi Endorsed for Congress in NY 16 by Labor Groups
## Diverse Group of Unions Emphasize Gashi's Values, Experience & Positions on Key Issues for Working Families
## [Lloyd Trufelman, Community Contributor](https://act.myngp.com/el/1pqaLkEUcN07K3qvdaxO18kjrrhdVf6-wGAB5ZqfcNI=/Q4XmSJGpTddZ2NcOXBAqbhE1BJLRLugENEUb_QZh8M0=)
## Posted Mon, Jul 25, 2022 at 12:30 pm ET
Westchester County Legislator Vedat Gashi, Candidate for Congress (GashiforCongress.com)
A diverse group of labor organizations in and around Westchester have endorsed [Vedat Gashi](https://act.myngp.com/el/1pqaLkEUcN07K3qvdaxO18kjrrhdVf6-wGAB5ZqfcNI=/9N0x9S1Wv5IgH4r6T1maSOs5GwV23JimqYaQ92gNUEk=) in the August 23 Democratic congressional primary for NY 16, emphasizing that Gashi's experience, values and positions on economic development and infrastructure issues make him well suited to advocate for workers and their families.
"I'm humbled to receive the support of this large group of important labor organizations," said Gashi, who currently serves as a Westchester County legislator. "I look forward to working with them to improve conditions and deliver results for working families across NY 16".
"Our campaign will fight to protect working families and help the middle class, because this district deserves a representative who supports mainstream Democratic policies and will put progress before posturing and work hard to deliver tangible results for everyday New Yorkers," Gashi noted, adding, "we're focused on making real progress on kitchen table issues like holding down taxes, lowering health care costs, strengthening our infrastructure, and improving our economy".
The endorsing labor organizations are: Asbestos Workers Local 91; Boilermakers Local 5; Bricklayers Allied Crafts Local 5; Building Laborers Local 235; Building Trades Council; Dock Builders Local 1556; Ironworkers Local 40; Ironworkers Local 417; Laborers Local 60; Northeast Regional Council of Carpenters Local 279; Operating Engineers Local 137; Ornamental Ironworkers Local 580; Painters District Council 9; Plumbers/Steamfitters Local 21; Road Sprinkler Local 669; Teamsters Local 456; Teamsters Local 813; Teamsters Local 814 and Tile, Marble, and Terrazzo Local 7. Additional endorsements will be announced by Gashi's campaign in the coming weeks.
[New York's 16th congressional district](https://act.myngp.com/el/1pqaLkEUcN07K3qvdaxO18kjrrhdVf6-wGAB5ZqfcNI=/UxI461k9k3I008-O3Fw5o_Fl1LvZvwpST4mA8t_F9xM=?districtType=cd&propA=current_2012&propB=congress_specialmastermay20_20220520&selected=-73.769,40.942) for the United States House of Representatives includes part of the northern Bronx and the southern half of Westchester County, including the cities of Mount Vernon, New Rochelle, Rye, White Plains and Yonkers.
Westchester and Bronx residents interested in Gashi's campaign can visit [https://www.vedatgashi.com/](https://act.myngp.com/el/1pqaLkEUcN07K3qvdaxO18kjrrhdVf6-wGAB5ZqfcNI=/9N0x9S1Wv5IgH4r6T1maSOs5GwV23JimqYaQ92gNUEk=), [https://www.facebook.com/GashiforCongress](https://act.myngp.com/el/1pqaLkEUcN07K3qvdaxO18kjrrhdVf6-wGAB5ZqfcNI=/5t34QDTqQ3B8qHuaHbB4L3CEJteeyyN_tnn9OizX1GE=), [https://www.instagram.com/vedatgashi/](https://act.myngp.com/el/1pqaLkEUcN07K3qvdaxO18kjrrhdVf6-wGAB5ZqfcNI=/3Jgb0m7un2h3vOmx0T7_8zQuKBcpPgojMH2jamsQguo=) and [https://twitter.com/legislatorgashi](https://act.myngp.com/el/1pqaLkEUcN07K3qvdaxO18kjrrhdVf6-wGAB5ZqfcNI=/54wY8EgC4CDbpSp6fEQOqIbZXvkoZXkcb-lhVg8D0Ho=) to learn more, volunteer, and contribute.

Hello,
Well, it didn’t take long. **Less than an hour after I was declared the Democratic nominee for Senate in Iowa, the attacks from Chuck Grassley began.**
_“The most liberal nominee in Iowa Senate history”
“Radical”
“Socialist”_
Gotta love it!
Chuck Grassley doesn’t know what to say about me. He’s never faced an opponent like me before. I’m his political nightmare, so he’s just throwing cow pies at the wall and hoping something sticks.
Calling me “radical” is laughable when Chuck Grassley supports a complete ban on abortion and letting literally anyone buy an AR-15 without even a background check. **But there’s one attack that I absolutely won’t take lying down, and that’s Chuck Grassley’s attacking me for serving our country for 36 years in the U.S. Navy.**
Grassley is already trying to say that because I enlisted in the military at age 19, because my deployments meant that my family had to move from state-to-state and country-to-country... that I’m not an Iowan anymore.
Chuck Grassley wants to pretend that I wasn’t raised in rural, northwest Iowa. He ignores the enormous sacrifices that my family – my wife and my kids – made to allow me to serve in the Navy.
**Grassley’s attacks denigrate every servicemember and every military family that has to pack up, change schools, say goodbye to friends, spend holidays away from each other, and be absent from life’s big events like weddings and the birth of a child.**
**And if Chuck Grassley thinks that I will stand silent while he says that every Iowan who puts on our country’s uniform stops being an Iowan... he’s delusional.**

Friend: I am coming up on a major midnight fundraising deadline – and in a race as competitive as this, it couldn't be more important to kick off with the strongest possible start.
I'm sure your inbox is filled with emails right now, but **this isn't the typical kind of fundraising message you might expect, so I hope you'll keep reading. What I'm about to tell you is why I decided to run, and it's important. **
When I'm in the middle of make-or-break moments for my Senate race like this deadline, my mind often goes back to Jacksonville – back to the tiny house I grew up in with six brothers and sisters. Things weren't always easy. Mom was a maid, Dad was a janitor, and although we didn't have a lot of money, we had each other.
In fact, it was Mom who used to say to me: "Never grow tired of doing good, Val." This inspired me to get into public service, and ever since, growing tired of doing what's right has never been an option. From my time as a social worker, a police chief and a representative in Congress, I've held this mantra close to my heart.
**_Never tire, _I remind myself, as experts say my race in Florida is one of Democrats' best opportunities to protect and expand our Senate majority.**

**_Never tire_ , I repeat, as polls show me statistically tied with my extremist opponent.

_Never tire_ , I say, ****as I head into yet another midnight fundraising deadline thousands****of dollars behind where I need to be.**
The fact of the matter is that a 50-50 Senate isn't working for you or our country. So my promise to you is this: **I will _never tire_ in this work to expand our majority and secure a future for voting rights, reproductive freedom and all our shared values.**
**[I ask a lot of you because I have so much faith that you'll never tire _, _either. You know the stakes of this election, so before one of the most important fundraising deadlines of the election year thus far, will you chip in $5 or more right now? body:
Hi there, I am reaching out to personally ask for your financial support.
We are throwing out the old, failed playbook and running the kind of grassroots campaign it takes to win this U.S. Senate seat in North Carolina.
It is a significant undertaking, but it is working. The polls show we’re tied with our opponent, and nonpartisan experts consistently rate this one of the seats “most likely to flip.”
We would not be in the strong position we are in today without the tens of thousands of small-dollar donors powering this campaign. But right now, we need you to join them.
Can you please split a donation to our campaign and Kirsten Gillibrand? Our opponents and the media are going to try to drown us out with attack ads, and we need resources to fight back. [http://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/beasley_gfs?refcode=jtk3561-bu-nd-v2]

>
Look, I wish I didn’t have to ask you to give today, but these Senate races are just so expensive — especially when we’re trying to do it the right way by rejecting corporate PAC money.
It takes an enormous amount of resources to run a campaign that can organize and reach voters in every part of this state, from the mountains to the coast, rural and urban alike.
Unfortunately, we know that we still have to raise more money because GOP super PACs are planning to dump at least $27 million more into this race on TV ads — on top of the more than $6 million they’ve already spent against me.
So if we want to flip this seat and expand our majority, then we have to hit our goal this month. Right now, we’re pacing behind, and the only way to make sure we don’t fall short is by asking supporters like you.
Will you split a donation between our campaign and Kirsten Gillibrand to help us close the gap and secure a historic victory in November? [http://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/beasley_gfs?refcode=jtk3561-bu-nd-v2]
This race is likely to decide whether or not we have 51 votes in the Senate to codify abortion rights, act on climate and defend democracy. If you help me win, I promise that I will cast that deciding vote for progress.
Thank you so much for your support!
- Cheri

Peter, I’m truly grateful for staunch allies like you.

_**It wouldn’t be right to go another day without expressing my gratitude for your unwavering support of my re-election campaign.**_

As Election Day nears, I’m taking some time to think back over the events that unfolded during my first term as Governor.

Do you remember Biden’s Democrat allies in the legacy media running to cover for Dr. Fauci by supporting unscientific lockdowns and the harmful masking of our children?

Or the Biden administration blatantly and disgracefully colluding with Big Tech to silence free speech and cancel all dissent during the pandemic?

_Fortunately, they were not the only ones with access to COVID data..._

As Governor of Florida, I reached out to and spoke with some of the best scientists and doctors in the world at Harvard, Stanford, and Oxford to assess the necessity of the Left’s destructive lockdown policies.

**The data showed the Left’s draconian policies were failures, and I kept Florida open. And I’m glad I did.**

**Every American has a right to work.**

**Every business has a right to operate.**

That’s why I stepped in and stopped local governments from restricting people from working or operating a business. _**[Do you support my decision to keep Florida open? Stand with me now.>>>](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=5a471935ac3547a89ae9f5856e02de7f&_e=z69Q1U9d9HDCd9vdAXRTZHYdtIyOwjMMP-QRHdKHqSso9rVu3E5vm5BlwkPt02ZTPuRT2s4RV5NNQeE4BlhzOS5NeyOfwtq7OCeBSr51RAtoaHIVoCOgzioAmAervt5V1awKkqKc6BoGHbXhcHEOcX-DyCn-ljm6JLBQqLSEhyvsQ2b84GghDfQKtn1CezxZAfaKA8MUI_FTSSwqQ8l5ZsEismLtqFpgoJAQ82mH_L-sZpUJ0davxjodUFc2-POMiTMX2pLWfUtHikaTk-yLlfCOTqPaOLuUnWxCH815zH7a8ZDXGVqVsXF4ieP8Q0phZfRgq1hWMtJk7rw7BnlrtBpmEKidAHj-Jgri516UcBS4GsnTpLFrg0ojdDGWVZThz3itvKMuV0ySn34OnwlFRXHV8q4DJwfqYNJ42EWkRQ4%3D "Do you support my decision to keep Florida open? Stand with me now.>>>")**_

I even issued pardons for those who were threatened by local governments with jail and ridiculous fines for operating during the pandemic.

I put my entire political career on the line to Keep Florida Free._** I fought back.**_

It showed you exactly the kind of leader I am._ I don’t cower with fear about what the media may say — I just lead._

In 2019, when I was inaugurated as Florida’s 46th Governor, I didn’t let the grass grow under my feet before turning the Tallahassee establishment upside down.

I immediately fulfilled several of my key campaign promises to Floridians, including:

✅ Changing the Florida Supreme Court for a generation by appointing three rock-solid conservative justices.

✅ Signing the largest expansion of school choice in the nation, giving parents greater freedom to choose the education that best meets their child’s needs.

✅ Restoring election integrity by holding election officials accountable by accepting the resignation of Broward County Supervisor of Elections Brenda Snipes from public office, as well as suspending Palm Beach County Election Supervisor Susan Bucher.

✅ Suspending Broward County Sheriff Scott Israel for his failure to protect the students at Marjorie Stoneman Douglas High School during the massacre at Parkland in 2018.

Of course, making these moves during my first few days in office was just a preview of what I set out to accomplish.

**Over my first three years, I’ve continued to steer Florida to a strong, safe, prosperous future with liberty as my guide and the Constitutions as my north star.**
_**[Do you think Florida is headed in the right direction? Rush in any amount now to keep our accomplishments going for another four years!](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=5a471935ac3547a89ae9f5856e02de7f&_e=z69Q1U9d9HDCd9vdAXRTZHYdtIyOwjMMP-QRHdKHqSso9rVu3E5vm5BlwkPt02ZTPuRT2s4RV5NNQeE4BlhzOS5NeyOfwtq7OCeBSr51RAtoaHIVoCOgzioAmAervt5V1awKkqKc6BoGHbXhcHEOcX-DyCn-ljm6JLBQqLSEhyvsQ2b84GghDfQKtn1CezxZAfaKA8MUI_FTSSwqQ8l5ZqiFNkVNDE_Z7a9LQe9YpG1lSbOeTZtRSsGetI3IhK5YcrJ8JTw5WjY7aIu_cVY9c9EhUM6iMziKiAD7_ZrVrmGf584wSYujYSg_cDucNz1mBUeQZ_Q4NQuxNp27HlkDEqD_JVYLMTBd7Qj_-OB_r99mU1O_qGedpGujHi_ZOwUjNmKKq3SvJdKTPCpdSZYEyfomuTdDfxyutmGqT4lsDl8%3D "Do you think Florida is headed in the right direction? Rush in any amount now to keep our accomplishments going for another four years!")**_
I refuse to simply kick the can down the road or seek out the path of least resistance when it comes to doing the right thing.

I certainly don’t set my priorities according to what is preferred by Silicon Valley’s CEOs, Big Tech’s shady algorithms, or the corrupt media’s agenda!

I refuse to bow to pressure from the Biden administration, kiss the ring of power-hungry government bureaucrats like Fauci, or follow orders from woke corporations who want to dictate to us how to live and what to think.

_**I was elected to lead, not to follow.**_

As was the case when I was in the U.S. Navy, my mission has always been to advocate for the people I serve.

I’m proud that because of my work these last few years, Florida is known as _the freest state in the country._

Yet rather than celebrate our economy, our school children being freed of compulsory masking, and the influx of overtaxed Americans who are voting with their feet to move to Florida, I am being attacked by my Democrat opponents.

I know you understand that coordinated attacks and vitriol against a successful conservative Republican like me is business as usual from the lockdown Democrats. It’s pathetic to see my political opponents and detractors whine about my record of accomplishments.

**As Governor of Florida, I’ll never stop defending the pro-liberty, pro-free market policies that make Florida the beachhead of freedom for the nation.**

My re-election campaign sent SHOCK WAVES through the Democrat media complex when we announced a $5 MILLION ad reservation targeting Hispanic voters.

With the Biden regime publicly cozying up to communist dictators in Cuba and Venezuela, you can be sure every victim of communism across the state is more willing than ever to reject the Democrat Party's choice for Governor this November.

**I’m going to battle for every vote.**

As you may remember, I narrowly won by a margin of just 0.4% four years ago during my first race for Governor!

We truly must be prepared for another knock-down, drag-out fight.

Now, with just months to go until Election Day, I’m asking you to stand with me again by making another generous contribution to my campaign today.

With November fast approaching, I’m hoping you can double your most generous gift.
**[[PLEDGE YOUR GIFT NOW]](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=5a471935ac3547a89ae9f5856e02de7f&_e=z69Q1U9d9HDCd9vdAXRTZHYdtIyOwjMMP-QRHdKHqSso9rVu3E5vm5BlwkPt02ZTPuRT2s4RV5NNQeE4BlhzOS5NeyOfwtq7OCeBSr51RAtoaHIVoCOgzioAmAervt5V1awKkqKc6BoGHbXhcHEOcX-DyCn-ljm6JLBQqLSEhyvsQ2b84GghDfQKtn1CezxZAfaKA8MUI_FTSSwqQ8l5Zqeu05IsQLZte3eAe__RbSeQG29y2M5VKE7zRDp1MXM4dVu9c7P-PK3qQdASVVuxl-SQoNXWFRADFYamb5Hc7iPjkAnehJcPvadkVWkI2HU_ccFQiggiy8L4DSb_rwT1PhDU9wOh0GISBOrcgKIBPtA-bdWkUwgQg6xQo47XebL_2ldb13MVyu78HB3WV723YgJiLxEix1s9sL6WSJgEG4o%3D "\[PLEDGE YOUR GIFT NOW\]")**
Regardless of the amount, I simply must have your continued support to be ready to respond to the next round of distortions and lies my Biden-loving opponents hurl at me.

_Peter, I’m incredibly grateful to you for your continued support._

No matter the amount, I thank you in advance for continuing to stand with me as I lead by example and fight back against the heavy hand of Biden’s big government.

GWINN, Mich. — Former Representative Bart Stupak, a Democrat, served the district for 18 years until 2011. Since then, Lorinser says, 'Yoopers' and Northern Michiganders haven't changed much. "There are voters in my district who believe mainstream, establishment politicians are no longer representative of their values," [said Dr. Lorinser.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48334723/357855420/-2079892654?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85Mjc5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NmIzOTk2NS1mNjBjLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=EmOic4b_rklkbHb9-2LcrBOGdQYLqCVGcPdJQ5H1-zk=&emci=4d20c310-f20c-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=66b39965-f60c-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=15167427) "Which means it's my party's duty to reignite our understanding of rural America." Dr. Bob is earning voters' trust. He says he rarely receives criticism about his positions on issues. Currently, constituents' primary concerns are inflation, gas and food prices, and the rising cost of rent. "Many believe the Democratic Party is responsible," says Dr. Bob. "But, both parties have their faults, and hardworking rural families often face the brunt of these economic burdens. My goal is to listen and put forward real solutions that will solve these problems, not convince voters the problems don't exist." Alternatively, Lorinser's opponent, incumbent Rep. Jack Bergman (R, MI1), is solely focused on blaming Democrats. "Record grocery and gas prices," said Bergman. "Highest illegal border crossings in history. Skyrocketing inflation. The Democrat-led Congress and President are derelict in their duty to the American people." "My opponent wants to play the blame game, but he offers no meaningful solutions," Lorinser claims. "It's unacceptable. Combating inflation and advocating for economic growth requires leadership and compromise from both sides. The American people deserve better than for us to make this a partisan problem." Skeptics often ask Dr. Bob how frequently he'll vote in lockstep with his party or how he'll practice independence when elected. Will he be another stooge to Speaker Pelosi, President Biden, Gov. Whitmer, or Sen. Schumer? "I never thought my vote was for or against a party. My vote will be my best assessment for America, my district, and its people," says Lorinser. Dr. Bob may be a rookie candidate, but he's not a novice to politics, leadership, or solving problems. "Being a political outsider is actually a huge advantage," says Lorinser. Fellow American, We knew it was just a matter of time before another woke company canceled us... but we didn't see this one coming. A few weeks ago, we received an unexpected email from Front, the company that manages all inbound and outbound email for the team here at the Babylon Bee, informing us that they had terminated our account, effective immediately. Sure enough, moments later, we were unable to send or receive email. For weeks afterwards, our team scrambled. We’re a company spread across multiple cities, so email is essential to our operation. Needless to say, this one hurt. Front decided to drop the bomb on us in whatever way would disrupt us the most, and they succeeded. But _why_ would they do such a thing? By now, I'm sure you have a good guess. It probably comes as no surprise that Front is run by a group of woke, left-wing tech elitists. Just like Twitter, Facebook, _The New York Times_ , Snopes, and the many other companies that have attacked us, they simply can’t abide satire that dares to mock their left-wing orthodoxy. So they orchestrated their attack to do the most damage they possibly could. [**We’ve been through attacks like this before, and we know that there are more coming — which is why I'm reaching out to free speech-loving friends like you who value good satire, asking you to become a paid subscriber of the Babylon Bee today.**](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zh53vefbgvuop6ov7u19866indc3eov5t475odbg_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s3gmeor4c9h2bs)

---

If you're familiar with the Babylon Bee, you know that we're no strangers to this sort of treatment. We've been canceled, censored, shadow-banned, locked out, and kicked off by more left-wing operations than I can count, for no other reason than that the woke just can’t take a joke. As a matter of fact, we've been locked out of our Twitter account for the past three months because we refuse to delete our satirical post honoring transgender Biden appointee Dr. Rachel Levine as our “Man of the Year.” But thanks to our network of subscribers, we can weather these storms better than ever before. To paraphrase the great sage himself, with friends like you united behind us, the woke tech elites can’t win. | | Derek, Good news — our bill to encourage the manufacturing of semiconductors in the United States, instead of outsourcing it to China and other countries, is headed to a vote in the full Senate. This legislation is a big deal for Virginia and for the rest of the country. It’s going to create jobs, increase our global economic competitiveness, boost national security, and drive innovation. **And now this bill is close to crossing the finish line — it’s time to show your support.** _[**Will you add your name now to call on the Senate to pass our CHIPS for America Act?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48339604/357873770/-334246048?ms=mw_em_220726_1&refcode=mw_em_220726_1&amount=5&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=Manassas&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MWMyYzdhYy0wMTBkLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=IDefltHbWrIMOT6bebVZbDlUqvC2_xKgG3HuIc25_hc=&emci=9f615e42-490c-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=91c2c7ac-010d-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=4568237)_ \---------- Original Message from Senator Mark Warner \--------- Derek, I wanted to provide an update on some important job-creating legislation I’m working on in the Senate. This is probably one of the wonkier emails I’m going to send you, but it’s about a subject that is critical to both our economic and national security, and I want to make sure my friends and supporters know what I’m working on. The truth is, the United States has allowed China and other countries to out-invest us in the manufacturing and innovation sectors. A key area – semiconductor manufacturing – has been especially challenging for our manufacturers and our economy at large to overcome. That’s why I sponsored a bipartisan bill called the _CHIPS for America_ Act. It will deliver a record $52 billion investment in emerging tech manufacturing, like semiconductor production. This historic investment would be felt across the innovation economy and would be a true game changer for Americans manufacturing everything from airplanes to smart phones to household appliances and more. Moreover, it would be a major incentive for semiconductor manufacturers to produce their products domestically. For Virginia and the rest of the country, that would mean good-paying jobs and a stronger supply chain. We can’t afford to miss this opportunity. Already, we’ve passed versions of this legislation in both the House and the Senate, but we still need to reach a final agreement reconciling the versions before it can become law. And I’m pleased to share with you, Derek, that I’m joining the conference committee tasked with negotiating this final deal on our key bipartisan economic competitiveness legislation and getting it to President Biden’s desk. We can’t let this moment go to waste. Derek. I’m committed to getting this done and I look forward to sharing more details with you all as we advance this legislation and get it signed into law. Thank you, Mark **[CONTRIBUTE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48339605/357873771/-1312564593?refcode=mw_em_220726_1&amount=5&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=Manassas&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MWMyYzdhYy0wMTBkLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=IDefltHbWrIMOT6bebVZbDlUqvC2_xKgG3HuIc25_hc=)**

Hey team,

The January 6 hearings have made one thing abundantly clear: our democracy is under an all-out assault.

That’s why I’m so concerned about Tom’s opponent, team. Kean Jr. is running for Congress for his FOURTH time — but after 20 years of playing politics in Trenton and coasting along on his dad’s reputation, Kean Jr. STILL can’t put together a single sentence on why he deserves to represent our state.

In fact, beyond an all out embrace of the Trump agenda (“Whatever Trump Does, Tom Kean Jr. Has His Back!”), Kean Jr. doesn’t have anything to say on how he plans to help our communities through the realities we now face. While New Jersey families are struggling to shoulder the cost of living and worrying about the country their kids will inherit, Kean Jr. can’t come up with a single answer – and his record in Trenton is more of the same. Instead, Kean Jr. dodges questions, hides from reporters, and refuses to talk to constituents — just as he’s done for the last two decades.

Team, New Jerseyans deserve better than Kean Jr. representing them in Congress. And his track record of spinelessness (especially in the face of extremism) is the LAST thing we need from our politicians right now. With democracy in danger, we need leaders who consistently stand up for our principles and put country over party — like Tom Malinowski has done his entire career. Meanwhile, Kean Jr. has refused to say whether he thinks the 2020 election was stolen, refused to refute Trump’s Big Lie, and refused to show a shred of integrity around defending our democracy.

body:
Welcome the Arizona Freedom Caucus! | | | |
---
| | | Patriots,

This past Friday, we helped launch the Arizona Freedom Caucus, the 7th state to join our State Freedom Caucus Network. Below is a Q&A session that we did with its chairman, Jake Hoffman. We hope you enjoy it.
---
|
---
From Left to Right: SFCN President Andy Roth, Arizona State Rep. John Fillmore, AZFC Chairman and State Rep. Jake Hoffman, State Rep. Jacqueline Parker, and Congressman Andy Biggs.
|
## **Q &A: Representative Jake Hoffman, AZFC Chairman**
---
| **Let’s start by getting to know you a bit. Can you tell us a bit about where you were born, what your upbringing was like, and how that influences your political philosophies today? ** Like many in the Grand Canyon state, I'm a proud escapee of the Marxist hellscape known as California. I was born and raised in the Bay Area, growing up in the Los Gatos/San Jose area of Silicon Valley by two loving parents who worked hard for everything they had. We went to church every Sunday and from even my earliest memories I can recall my parents talking about American virtues like character, ethics, morals, and the value of hard work. While themes like this were common in my household, we were not a political family. We didn't do politics. We weren't grassroots activists. We were simply a normal hardworking family that understood, through experience, the exceptionalism and unbridled opportunity of our great nation. Building my life upon the bedrock of Christ, supplemented by a profound gratitude for the blessing of this nation, continues to serve even today as the underpinnings of my political philosophy as an unabashed constitutional conservative. **Why did you choose to run for office? What made you want to be such a strong conservative even if it meant standing up to powerful people? ** I had always considered myself to be an informed American—I watched the news, listened to talk radio, and read just about any news story I could get my hands on; but in early 2012 something changed. I got fed up watching politicians and pundits on TV give seeming dissertations on governance, social values, and politics, only they never meant a damn word of it. Their rhetoric was simply that, empty bloviation. By 2012, most Americans with their eyes open could see America's ship heading for the rocks due to Democrats increasingly public embrace of radical Marxist ideology and I couldn't sit on the sidelines while they dismantled the greatest nation in world history, so I ran for office. Once elected, I decided to let my faith and the values that had been instilled in me from an early age guide my actions. Like Galations 1:10 teaches, we aren't here to please worldly masters, we're here to do what is right, speak truth, and serve our Heavenly Father, no matter the consequences we may face in this realm. If Paul & Silas can rejoice and worship while chained to a wall in prison, we too can have the courage to follow where He calls and stand for what is right. **What made you want to form a Freedom Caucus in Arizona? ** The House Freedom Caucus is a beacon of hope in a very dark city. My good friend, and congressman, Andy Biggs was serving as the Chairman of the House Freedom Caucus and we would often talk about the importance of the states and that the true reclamation of this nation would come from the power of the states. Unfortunatley, for far too long states, specifically state legislatures, have ceded their power to the federal government or to their own state's executive branch. Having watched the success of the House Freedom Caucusin serving as a check on the establishment's power in DC, it became abundantly clear that one was needed in each of the 50 states. **What do you view as the most immediate need that the legislature should act on to expand the freedoms of Arizonans? ** Americans have been watching their freedoms and opportunities be stripped away for more than 100 years, so I believe there is much work to do to remold our government in the limited government spirit that our Founding Fathers envisioned. It is indisputable that election integrity and ensuring voters can have confidence in both the process and outcomes of our elections has become the civil rights issue of our day. We must continue to make common sense reforms that make our elections safe, secure and convenient; however, the work doesn't end there. Arizonans need more than simply the freedom to trust the outcome of their elections, it is incumbent upon us as legislators that we do everything within our power to protect them from the invasion on our southern border, liberate them from the theft of taxation and the burden of regulation, defend them from the radical social experimentation of the Democrats' Marxist agenda, and empower them to live the lives they choose, so long as it neither picks another's pocket, nor breaks another's leg.

How does it change the way you conduct business in the legislature? ** Arizona bungled redistricting in 2010, which practically contributed to a slow and steady decline in the Republican majority. Compounding the situation was milquetoast leadership that accepted the status quo more often than they were willing to challenge it. Fortunately, conservatives were organized in advance of the 2020 redistricting process to ensure that a truer reflection of the voice of the majority of Arizonans was realized in the final redistricting maps. We will see larger, more conservative majorities for much of the next decade. **How do Arizona Freedom Caucus members stay focused amidst attacks from the Left and the GOP establishment? ** The Arizona Freedom Caucus has been informally operating for two legislative sessions together and members have built a strong trust amongst themselves that allows them to act as both a support and accountability structure for one another. When new members are considered for an invitation to join the Freedom Caucus one of the key factors we look at is do they have the courage to forge ahead when it feels like the entire system is stacked against them. Arizona Freedom Caucus members refuse to quit. **What does the Arizona Freedom Caucus hope to achieve in the next legislative session? ** We are currently developing the Arizona First 2023 agenda that will be able to serve as a roadmap for all conservatives at the Arizona Capitol for the upcoming legislative session. This agenda includes policy areas such as election integrity, tax reform, budget reform, border security, supporting our brave police officers, reigning in the power and size of government, defending the Second Amendment, protecting children from sexual grooming at the hands of government-run schools, and more. We're eager to see common sense reforms on these issues be enacted and signed into law. Each of the focus areas in our Arizona First 2023 plan will indisputably benefit every Arizonan.

body:
I’d like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zq3bikk1e18k5esssd3415m7scjseqsqjt6vaj0g_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s3im6or6cph238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq8ddl69qbcd1jm4qj6d9jmpqj7d9neppqcdtlmui34thgmipnadt4sbp65sj76spr7dpkmirj8spmm2oeacb76hhm9c3hmor78sj4m6pb3d75c1in4t1lcioefkjge9i3cc5icpp78cbmc3gb8p9gs2qj2p76cpj33dpl6hg74dj664pb6phnm2qmash5u)

| | | Friend,

I'd like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out. I know I've been emailing, texting, and calling more than normal right now, but I need to reach my goal by midnight and need you to listen to me.

I hope you know me to be an honest man of integrity, so I thought I'd take a second to walk you through why I'm running for office and why this deadline means so much.

---
| [](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zb1vu98pajg3t803os05ddftkj651jdvdqltv0po_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s3im6or6cph2bs)
---

This is a photo of my dad (of course wearing a Miami Dolphins shirt). He was the best role model for being a father, a friend, and an American.

He and my mom thankfully came to America before the murderous dictator Fidel Castro came to power and turned Cuba to a dangerous socialist wasteland. After my parents saw what he had done to their homeland, they decided to stay put in America and get to work to achieve the American Dream.

---
| [](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zf6itqtabccpajtr844s9qd0540n251tvbe5m2l8_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s3im6or6cph2bs)
---

Eventually, my sister and I became first generation college graduates, and while we had to take on student loans to do so, we knew the work ethic our parents instilled would help us pay them down once we graduated.

I met my wife Jeanette through mutual friends and we got married in 1998. We started our beautiful family of four kids: Amanda, Daniella, Anthony, and Dominick. We eventually adopted two dogs, Winston and Arthur (who I found with my laptop typing some emails to you recently...).

---
| [](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zl6066p5l8k7n3gvc8gmftc7v9e0kcvnpp4lffpo_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s3im6or6cph2bs)
---

All jokes aside, being a father to my wonderful kids is by far my favorite and most important job, and I will never take that for granted.

I first ran for Senate because I saw what Barack Obama and Joe Biden's policies were doing to families like mine. More families were living paycheck to paycheck at the expense of tax-and-spend Democrats. My parents taught me to work if I wanted to make a change, so that's exactly what I did.

My dad never got to see me become a U.S. Senator in the country he immigrated to in order to make a better life for us, but I carry his work ethic and family values with me every day in the Senate to honor him, and now, I'm teaching my kids exactly what he taught me.

---
| [](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zvcrut2ji725m605ctb40rabftlhatihv2mqurdo_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s3im6or6cph2bs)
---

After seeing the dysfunction in Washington firsthand, I decided to run for President so I could bring my passion for America to the White House. My loving family was right by my side, and I couldn't have been more grateful for their support.

I wanted to stop Hillary Clinton at all costs, and eventually, that meant dropping out of the race and working with Donald Trump to win. Throughout his term, we worked on pro-family and pro-veteran bills to make America great and restore the American Dream.

---
| [](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z7l8plbeq5ieuuadk6nasnhbct0vdrt0de0g140o_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s3im6or6cph2bs)
---

This brings me to my main point: I'm running for Senate because I will never stop fighting to restore the American Dream.

I feel so blessed looking through these photos, and I wanted to share them with you so you can understand where I am coming from.

Reaching these deadlines may seem like a fundraising ploy, but this is real. **If we 're outraised again, that will be a major step back in our fight to restore the American Dream.**
**[I hope you'll make a donation today and join this fight before my deadline:](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z1rjcbc9gttg3os6mp5kjc1h7mc09l8dn0lme5bg_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s3im6or6cph2bs)**
---
| | | [I'LL JOIN YOU, MARCO!](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zsf4os3tssjnfnhr6cb036f3c5tqioucdc9qiiv0_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s3im6or6cph2bs)
---
Thank you so much for taking the time to read this,

Marco Rubio
---
| | | | |
* * *
---
| [](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zafsrdqfhlc25ii4lcp6qe6k5r1g8ui119ut7b08_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s3im6or6cph2bs)
---
I talk to folks every day who say they haven't donated because they think they need to write a big check or they think my race isn't close.

Well, let me tell you, this race will be decided on a razor-thin margin. Currently, we're only separated by 2%, but considering the MILLIONS my opponent is raising, she could easily take the lead after smearing me in new campaign ads.

With such a tight race, any amount donated today can make a difference.

**[Please, can you give $4, 8, $12.55, or $17 today?](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zlrtiel6jfgqip3esg2sirqhb0rcthkgfeqaoo28_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s3im6or6cph2bs)**

body:
Please take this quick survey to tell us which voting rights issues are most important to you.

body:

---
| | Hi, Friend,

We are coming down to the wire and I can't thank you enough for all the support you've sent to Angie and me. God has been amazing to us!

I've asked you to volunteer. I've asked you to give. And countless people have done exactly these things.

Now, I am calling you to do something more important than anything else we've done. I'm calling the entire Alex Bryant for Congress team (including you) to a 3-Day Fast. Beginning Saturday morning, July 30th through Monday night August 1st, I'm asking you to fast and pray for the election on Tuesday, August 2nd.

I think you know that for Angie and me, this has been more of a spiritual journey than a political one. We've stepped out as God has called us to do. Our confidence comes from knowing that it is the Lord that orders our steps.

If prayer and fasting are a part of your spiritual disciplines, you know exactly what I'm asking of you. If it has not been, let me suggest some ways you can join me in this effort:
* Fast and pray one meal each day
* Fast and pray meals as the Lord directs
* Fast and pray for one full day, two days or all three days
* Fast and pray, consuming liquids only

My view is that a true spiritual fast includes fasting from food. You are acknowledging that your strength is not in food, rather it is in the Lord. Then, in addition to fasting food, you may choose to fast TV, social media, or other things that consume your time. And then PRAY!

Be sure to note that for a fast to be effective, you have to pray during the time where you would normally consume food. If you don't pray, then your "not eating" is not a fast, it's just a diet!

Here are a few things I'd like for you to pray for during the fast:
* Physical and spiritual strength for Angie and me
* Complete healing for Mason
* Effectiveness of all TV, radio and social media paid advertising
* Wisdom and favor for me as I continue to interact with voters and the media

You cannot know how much this means to me, that you will join me during these three days. Let's consider it three days to change the direction of the 7th Congressional District and the nation.
3-Day Fast July 30th to August 1st
Your fresh voice for our values,
---
|
---
| Alex Bryant
Candidate for Congress
Missouri's 7th District

Friend, Here in District 19, I am committed towards improving the quality of life, not just for Democrats, but for all residents. Whether one votes blue or red this November, I have their best interests at heart, something that Byron Donalds and the Republican Party cannot honestly say. **** I’m passionate about improving Southwest Florida, whether through cleaning up our environment, ensuring our seniors have a safe future, providing more local public transportation options, or many more of my initiatives designed to improve the region. **** The GOP has failed Southwest Florida. They’ve allowed big polluters to destroy our beautiful natural environment. They’ve restricted the rights of women, minorities, and the LGBTQ community. They’ve put our seniors’ futures in jeopardy with attacks on social security. They've refused to help us fight the COVID-19 pandemic, and have made our efforts harder by restricting our access to vaccines and masks. **** We need to vote the GOP out and elect leaders who are committed to delivering for the people of Southwest Florida, not just echoing partisan talking points. **** I promise that when I’m your representative, I won’t fight culture wars. I won’t cast meaningless votes. I’ll fully devote myself to serving you. That’s how democracy should work. Byron Donalds isn’t working for you. I will. subject: Mike Brown's Integrity Gap
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Schwab for SOS, Matthew Goddard, Treasurer
body:
| | | |
---
| | | Mike Brown has a lot to say about integrity, but consider these facts about his own integrity gap.

**Claim:** Mike vocally challenged Secretary Schwab on accepting Zuckerbucks in the 2020 elections.
**FACT: The Secretary of State did not accept Zuckerbucks. **Each county made the decision about whether to accept grant money from the Center for Tech and Civic Life, funded by Mark Zuckerberg. Mike said that anyone who accepted the money had "an obligation to know or should have known" who was behind the money. Yet, as Johnson County Commissioner, Mike [made the motion](https://scottschwab.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=637dedc6f5c04616f44b83bbf&id=dcf0f86d14&e=e4cd931cf2) to approve more than $856,000 in "Zuckerbucks" for the 2020 election. He even [called](https://scottschwab.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=637dedc6f5c04616f44b83bbf&id=11f40b21be&e=e4cd931cf2) the funds a "nice gift."

**Claim: **Mike opposed Covid-era mask mandates.
**FACT:** As Johnson County Commissioner, Mike allowed an extension of Governor Kelly's Covid mask mandate to go unchallenged. When he had the chance to call for a county commission vote on whether to extend the mandate, **[Mike stayed silent](https://scottschwab.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=637dedc6f5c04616f44b83bbf&id=82b47ba8c3&e=e4cd931cf2) **and the mask mandate was allowed to continue.

**Claim:** Mike supports transparency and ethics in government.
**FACT: **Mike [accepted thousands of dollars in anonymous online donations](https://scottschwab.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=637dedc6f5c04616f44b83bbf&id=e770df5f34&e=e4cd931cf2) in excess of the amount allowed by state ethics law.

**Claim:** Mike has the authority to ban ballot drop boxes.
**FACT:** Drop boxes are owned by the counties. The Secretary of State does not have the legal authority to ban or require the use of ballot drop boxes. The use is a decision that rests solely with the counties, not the Secretary of State, and is a matter of local control.

Mike talks a lot about integrity. It's just that - all talk.

Time and time again, Mike failed to act with integrity. He didn't act with integrity when he was county commissioner and he's already proven that he won't as Secretary of State.

Read on to learn more about them — and consider powering their campaigns to victory with a contribution! = | = Peter, I cannot stress enough how important November’s midterm elections will be to the future of our state. As we’ve seen, Republicans are eager to roll back our most fundamental rights and enact radical legislation that would be disastrous for North Carolina. If you share my priorities of protecting reproductive health care access, preventing gun violence, defending against climate change, and more, I hope you’ll join me in working to BLOCK a GOP supermajority in Raleigh. Electing Democratic allies is how we do it. I deeply appreciate your support for the candidates I’ve introduced you to so far. Today, I want to share three more candidates who will help build the firewall against the extreme legislation Republican leaders would like to pass — and I also need to ask you to = to help them win their critical elections: = Mary Wills Bode is an attorney, nonprofit leader, and lifelong North Carolinian. She’s now the Democratic nominee for the newly drawn State Senate District 18, encompassing her home region of Wake and Granville Counties. Public service runs in Mary’s family; her mother is a former secretary of North Carolina’s Department of Health and Human Services and her father is a retired Vietnam veteran and civic leader. Mary is ready to take up the mantle of service and fight for a better future for our communities. = = Marcia Morgan is a retired Army Colonel and a former educator who cares deeply about giving North Carolina children the best possible start in life. She knows the value and honor of public service, so she came out of retirement to step up as our Democratic nominee for State Senate District 7. Marcia has the leadership experience we need in Raleigh, and she has what it takes to win this competitive district if we all rally around her candidacy. = = Linda Cooper-Suggs is running for re-election to represent State House District 24. She’s a former educator with deep ties to Eastern North Carolina — including obtaining her Master’s Degree at East Carolina University after college at NC A&T State University. In her two years in office, Linda has supported efforts to improve educational opportunities for all NC students no matter their zip code and expand Medicaid so every North Carolinian can access the health care they need. She’s ready to keep working hard to deliver for our state next year. = Our ability to create progress on the issues that matter most comes down to electing Democratic legislators we can count on. Friends,
We are writing to you today because the threat of election denialism is still present in Colorado. subject: Why I'm running for Congress
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Alessandra Biaggi for Congress
body:
I know what it takes to go up against deep pockets and win
#

[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/biaggi-em-july/?refcode=em220726-1-t1&refcode2=946_59515_ut5soT&akid=946%2E59515%2Eut5soT)

I have about 15 minutes of free time this morning. I know it doesn't sound like a lot, but with the primary less than a month away, it's pretty rare to catch a breather like this.
I know our campaign sends many emails, but I wanted to take a few of those minutes today to talk about my decision to run for Congress, and why your support is so important.
Here's the truth: When I first ran for State Senate in 2018 against a seven-term incumbent, a lot of people thought I didn’t stand a chance — that I shouldn't waste my time.
But when I looked at the leadership we had in New York, I didn't see myself being represented. So many of our politicians lacked any urgency or understanding of what our communities needed — and I decided that was worth fighting back against. We were outspent 10 times over, and we won.
Now, I see the same lack of leadership and urgency in Washington today that I saw in Albany then.
Democrats have the opportunity to take bold action on the urgent issues of our time — the climate crisis, protecting abortion and voting rights, gun safety, health care as a human right... but so many of our leaders simply lack the political courage to act.
That's why I'm running — to take our movement's fight to Congress, and be a fearless voice for working people in NY-17 and across the country.
But here's another truth: Running the kind of campaign that can win takes a lot of resources. Especially when my opponent has the support of the entire political establishment, and we're not taking a cent of corporate PAC money.
**I know what it takes to go up against deep pockets and win: A grassroots movement of lots and lots of people, ready to fight for change.**
The only way we'll win this race is together. So I have to ask:
[**Can you make a $3 contribution to our people-powered campaign for Congress today? body:
https://go.briandahle.com/givenow-em?source_code=email&utm_medium=email&utm_source=mailchimp-subscriber&utm_term=This is why grocery store prices are going up.
,

If you’re wondering why food prices in your local grocery stores have gone up so much under Newsom’s administration, this is why.

Transporting food from the farms to your local markets has become incredibly difficult for the shipping industry.

Just last week, we talked to a group of truckers protesting AB 5, a law I voted against, but pushed forward by Gavin Newsom that requires all independently contracted truckers to either become employees beholden to company regulations or pay $20k in out-of-pocket permits and insurance. (You can read more about this horrible law here) (https://dailycaller.com/2022/07/22/truckers-newsom-relent-labor-law-protests-strikes-ports/?fbclid=IwAR20fIN4gZi2gL0KXphXbwCIFQoCkmstmLWGzislfTNXu92Z4Myw1JNAgR4?source_code=email&utm_medium=email&utm_source=mailchimp-subscriber&utm_term=This is why grocery store prices are going up.) .

This devastates over half of the truckers in California.

Now, because it is becoming more difficult for hard-working truckers to get food to the grocery stores across California, the grocery store prices will become even higher than they already are.

What’s even more frustrating is that even though many people are exempt from AB 5, independent truckers are not included in those exemptions.

The good news is that when I’m governor, we will put a stop to AB 5 and free up our supply chain so that food prices can start dropping.

California doesn’t have to be this expensive.

We don’t have to live in a constant state of crisis.

The Californian dream is just around the corner.

- Senator Brian Dahle

Friends, there is so much on the line — and on the ballot.
| | | [](https://barriertoentrypac.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb795e0b9271d112fbc5c1bd8&id=3c664f3b80&e=007b353608)

---
Hello B/E Team — We’re just **_ONE WEEK_** away from the primary elections here in Ohio. Even if you don’t live in our state, we just want to remind you how important it is to elect working-class progressives up and down the ballot and across the country.

**Meaningful change starts at the state level.** There’s so much on the line and so much on the ballot this year with states now holding even more responsibility to safeguard our fundamental rights where we cannot solely rely on the federal government to take bold enough measures. Many movements that have turned into federal law or widespread practice — like women’s suffrage, environmental protection, racial discrimination, minimum wage, marriage equality, cannabis decriminalization and more — all have their roots in state policy.

**In what has been historically a swing state, Ohio could be key to shaping our country’s future.** Already in Ohio this year, Republicans have succeeded in drawing unconstitutional, gerrymandered maps in their favor. They passed a gun law that went into effect last month legally permitting concealed carry of weapons — without a license, background check, or any training. And after the fall of Roe, they introduced a bill that would completely outlaw all abortions with the only exception being when the life of the mother is proven by their standards to be “endangered.” We urgently need to change Ohio’s course.

**Bria Bennett (for OH HD-64)** — _“I was born addicted to crack. This made it difficult for me to get adopted, but I was fortunate enough to be welcomed into a loving family. Forever grateful, I recognize that my life could have turned out very differently and that not everyone has the same opportunities or access to resources. This backstory is an inherent part of what drives me to fiercely protect and support working families. Being a young, progressive Black woman, I plan to lift up underserved communities and hope to empower the next generation of changemakers.”_

**Daniel Ortiz (for OH HD-43)** — _“Having lived my whole life in Toledo, I’m running to better the lives of those in the city that I love and call home. Raised by a single mom, I know what it’s like to face food and housing insecurity. I’ve lived paycheck to paycheck, have been buried in student loan debt, and have spent most of my career in the healthcare industry where I currently work as a pharmacy tech and I witness firsthand how devastating lack of public funding can be. As someone who has been left behind by a political system that only works for those at the top, I’m unapologetically pro-choice, pro-worker, pro-environment, and progressive.”_

**Without the resources from the B/E community including you, we simply wouldn’t have been able to run for office.** Both of us come from working-class backgrounds and face the socioeconomic barriers and biases that favor those with advantages, connections, and privileges. If we continue this cycle of electing elite, out-of-touch leaders, we will continue to get the same lack of deliverability and accountability. But your support has helped us break those barriers and run strong races that represent regular, hard-working people.

**Now, with __JUST 7 DAYS LEFT__ to reach voters with our messages, we need to remain competitive with our well-funded, well-connected opponents.** So we’re personally asking you today to give us a final boost so that we can equip the Ohio State Legislature with two working-class progressives who will combat far-right attacks and fight for everyday people. **[Please rush $25, $10 or anything you can right now to help take us and more working-class candidates like us all the way to the finish line. Elect Kevin Hayslett to Congress today! |

| Friends,

As I write this, many residents across Florida's 13th Congressional District are returning their mail ballots for the August 23 Republican Primary. I've been humbled by your calls, texts and emails letting me know that you voted for me by mail! With your help, we will secure a victory in this race for Pinellas values. My opponents moved from Washington D.C. and California ONLY to run for this office. I've spent my whole life here and this will always be my home.

I need your help sharing my candidacy with our Pinellas community. My team has created some graphics to help get the word out on social media (click below)— _**will you share a Facebook or Instagram post to let people know why you're on #TeamHayslett today?**_

---
| You can also download a Facebook cover photo to add to your profile. Please**add a cover photo to your Facebook page until Election Day on August 23 and share with your friends and family!

Choose an image below! #HayslettforCongress**

I'm the only candidate endorsed by four Sheriffs—including **Pinellas County's own Bob Gualtieri and Polk Sheriff Grady Judd** —in addition to dozens of local leaders such as Speaker of the House Chris Sprowls, Senator Ed Hooper, and Commissioner Kathleen Peters. As your Congressman, I'll fight Biden's historic inflation and secure our border. I will always be accessible to you and stay committed to our Pinellas values.

**I know I can count on you to create a social media post and change your Facebook cover photo to tell your followers why you're supporting my candidacy for Congress. **With the new District 13 boundaries, the question isn't whether or not we will elect a Republican in November, but what type of Republican do we want to send to Washington?

Yours in service,

subject: “Cave means grave”
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Kermit Jones for Congress
body:
| | The night before the January 6 attack on the U.S. Capitol, the leader of the Oath Keepers and the leader of the Proud Boys met in a parking garage. As the investigations continue, it has come to light that these far-right paramilitary groups:
* Were in direct communication with White House officials in the days leading up to the attack,

| | | | | Peter, I write with a simple request:[ Please follow me on Twitter](https://default.salsalabs.org/T3ee20ec5-7d06-47cc-8463-81afe718ca5e/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) if you have an account. The January 6th Hearings, authoritarian Supreme Court decisions, ongoing mass shootings and more make it so important our community amplifies our messages here, there and everywhere, to combat right-wing Republican attacks on all we hold dear. Twitter's a place where we test new ideas, put our messaging in front of journalists, respond to RW smears and more. It's become a partiuclarly important medium for politics, and will only be more so as we get closer to the 2022 midterm elections. [PLEASE FOLLOW @CLIFFSCHECTER ON TWITTER](https://default.salsalabs.org/T56266157-7bd8-4f5f-b2ac-6d1704c81ba9/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) We do our best to send you emails every day to financially support our best candidates and defeat their worst. But we are only going to send two emails per day, three when ireally necessary. We don't wish to inundate you. Meanwhile, on Twitter there's a constant conversation in real time, one that often defines whether we win or lose. So no huge ask here, [just please follow me there](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tccd590e8-fb69-42a1-84de-d705895e02e4/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9), where at least a dozen times per day I share news, ideas, pushback and more to fight the Republican menace. Thank you for all you do to keep fighting! Cliff

Dear Friend, While many people are familiar with David as the shepherd boy who slew the giant, they likely don’t know his full story—especially the tragedies that befall his family and his beautiful turn to repentance. In fact, at its heart, the story of David is about fathers and sons.

King David’s momentous story provides profound insights into many of life’s most important questions, including: What are my responsibilities to God? What do I owe my fellow man? How do I lead my family? How do I turn away from sin? What is the best way to lead others?

Taught by Hillsdale College Professor of English Justin Jackson, **“The David Story: Shepherd, Father, King”** examines the Old Testament books of First and Second Samuel. This eight-lesson course explores David’s character and the consequences of his choices on his family and the people of Israel.
---
| | **This is why we’ve produced our online course, “The David Story: Shepherd, Father, King,” which is now available on DVD. And you can reserve your copy using this secure link:**

**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/david-story-dvd](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zb3o65um2ul5mcsk4l8o44q07la0flt15t1gfr38_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s3hmaor2cph2bs)** By viewing the course, you’ll learn more about the nature of God, family, leadership, sin, and repentance; in short, you’ll learn more about what truly matters in life. **I hope you’ll reserve your DVD today and share its abiding lessons with your family and friends. The DVD is perfect for a Bible study or homeschool curriculum.**
---
| [](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zfdmtb75t3e1mcbrqfbrrr3jq8c01m4cj15rand0_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s3hmaor2cph2bs)
---
| | Let’s learn what truly matters in life by studying **“The David Story.”**

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, ’09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College

| | | Hi there,

Mark your calendars — Mike Van Someren for Congress has some events coming up!

[**Tonight, July 26th, Mike is hosting a listening session at the Muskego Public Library.**](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=b6ff1f84cf&e=356c0699dd) We as Americans can find a middle ground on many things, but our current representative, Scott Fitzgerald and his party, refuse to act. Whether it’s inflation, crime, healthcare, or climate change, Scott just votes “no” and points a finger.

**Mike is going to be a different kind of Congressman, one who listens to concerns of families, especially those worried about keeping a roof over their heads, food on the table or even finding baby formula.** [Join us for our listening session in Muskego tonight and let Mike know what is on your mind.](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=73909f4f2f&e=356c0699dd) What challenges are your friends and family facing and how would you like to see them addressed? Mike wants to hear what is important to you.
---
| [ ](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=5eb8bdc5f8&e=356c0699dd)
---
| [**Listening session**](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=a45a8513ff&e=356c0699dd)
Tuesday, July 26 | 6:30 -7:45PM
Muskego Public Library
S73W16663 W Janesville Rd
Muskego, WI 53150
[_No RSVP necessary — just be sure to come with your questions and concerns for the future of our state. _](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=5985dbe9d0&e=356c0699dd)
**Mike is running for Congress to bring common-sense leadership to Washington.** To be able to help regular folks who are putting in an honest day’s work to get ahead, while ensuring that programs are available for those that need help to get back on their feet.

To do this, he firmly believes we must level the playing field and rebuild the middle class. He even put out a detailed plan on how he intends to get the ball rolling once elected to Congress. **[Join us on Facebook Live Thursday, July 28th at 7:30 p.m.](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=32f7f3803a&e=356c0699dd) to have the chance to talk with Mike from the comfort of your own home.**

Facebook Live
Thursday, July 28 | 7:30
[_Ask Mike a question ahead of time here!_](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=a30e2bf595&e=356c0699dd)

| We need to focus on rebuilding the American middle class, so everyone gets a fair shake. Working 40 hours/week should mean the opportunity to own a home, raise our families, meet basic expenses, and save for a rainy day.

Scott Fitzgerald refuses to work for the middle class. YOU deserve better.

We hope to see you at our coming events!

Holly
Mike Van Someren for Congress HQ

"Tax cuts
for the rich" is a favorite argument of those who oppose lower
tax rates. But does imposing higher tax rates on wealthy
Americans actually increase the amount of revenue coming into the
federal government?

Hoover

Dear Peter,
Each year the Department of Defense (DoD) must send an assessment to the US Congress detailing “Military and Security Developments Involving the People’s Republic of China.”
China has the largest military in the world, with 2.8 million soldiers, sailors, and airmen, roughly twice the number in the services of the USA. Their military parades are designed to emphasize strength and intimidate the nearby smaller Asian democratic nations.

The US Air Force (USAF) and Navy have so-called 5th generation aircraft, the F-22 and F-35 jets, while China has modernized most of its obsolete jets with so-called 4th generation jets to close the technology gap. According to the DoD report, China now also has H-20 stealth bombers and FC-31 stealth fighter jets.

However, China is reported to operate only 3 refueling tanker planes, compared to several hundred in the USAF. China is reported to be converting Y-20 cargo planes into tankers, and is emphasizing naval aircraft carrier power as it seeks military parity or even domination to promote their national agenda. There is also an emphasis on computer based cyber-warfare.
The USAF has the immediate responsibility of maintaining and modernizing our fighter jets, bombers, refueling tankers, and cargo planes, but also providing our pilots with adequate training and practice flight time.

One of the constitutional responsibilities of Congress is to provide an adequate budget for our aircraft, pilots, mechanics, and support personnel. Although there are multiple interests competing for taxpayer dollars, the budget must provide our USAF with the fastest modern computers at both their desks and in the cockpits, and adequate funding for pilot retention and training.

The goal of congressional funding should be to build an “enduring military advantage”, likely the best deterrent to war. As your Congresswoman, this will be a priority in my first term.

clean_body: Keeping our Country safe | | | | | | | | Dear Peter, Each year the Department of Defense (DoD) must send an assessment to the US Congress detailing “Military and Security Developments Involving the People’s Republic of China.” China has the largest military in the world, with 2.8 million soldiers, sailors, and airmen, roughly twice the number in the services of the USA. Their military parades are designed to emphasize strength and intimidate the nearby smaller Asian democratic nations. The US Air Force (USAF) and Navy have so-called 5th generation aircraft, the F-22 and F-35 jets, while China has modernized most of its obsolete jets with so-called 4th generation jets to close the technology gap. According to the DoD report, China now also has H-20 stealth bombers and FC-31 stealth fighter jets. However, China is reported to operate only 3 refueling tanker planes, compared to several hundred in the USAF. China is reported to be converting Y-20 cargo planes into tankers, and is emphasizing naval aircraft carrier power as it seeks military parity or even domination to promote their national agenda. There is also an emphasis on computer based cyber-warfare. The USAF has the immediate responsibility of maintaining and modernizing our fighter jets, bombers, refueling tankers, and cargo planes, but also providing our pilots with adequate training and practice flight time. One of the constitutional responsibilities of Congress is to provide an adequate budget for our aircraft, pilots, mechanics, and support personnel. Although there are multiple interests competing for taxpayer dollars, the budget must provide our USAF with the fastest modern computers at both their desks and in the cockpits, and adequate funding for pilot retention and training. The goal of congressional funding should be to build an “enduring military advantage”, likely the best deterrent to war.
