Peter, this is a longer email, but it’s about life-changing decisions and I am sharing mine.

When I became pregnant with my first child, my life changed. I was in the Army and in Company Command. I was stripped of command and advised to resign my career in military leadership - something I’d worked years to achieve. Kevin and I married, and I became a stay-at-home military spouse and mother. I gave up the life I had planned. In later jobs, I was hired at entry-level positions because I had taken “time off” to parent.

As soon as I became a mother, I knew that my children would take priority in my life. **Yet, as a mom of three, I also feel strongly that parenthood is something _no one_ should be forced into against their will. Becoming a mother was the most defining moment of my life. That must be a personal decision.

[I’ll work hard to restore the right to choose once I’m in Congress, but I won’t make it there without your help. If you can, I need you to donate right now to help meet our $40,000 pre-primary fundraising goal before our election two weeks from today. Click here to give >>>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48339041/357872346/-174114498?amount=14&refcode=ea.ccdae72c-000d-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ms=ea.ccdae72c-000d-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzk0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjY2RhZTcyYy0wMDBkLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-Srwve85R2ccJ3vu3iKFcgaI7jnPBobup7DgYavTu8Q=)

_Roe_ has fallen, but the attack on our rights has just begun.** Without access to essential reproductive care, so many people who cannot afford to have another child, who didn’t plan on having children yet, or who never wanted to be parents will end up with altered lives.

Women will carry this burden. Women will have to give up their jobs because they can’t afford childcare. Women will be tied down to abusive partners because of financial instability. Women will leave the workforce in droves. Women will feel these effects for the whole of their lives.

The end of _Roe v. Wade_ set our progress toward equality for women back by half a century. Once again, too many women will be siloed into being only partners and mothers - no matter what they wanted for their lives.

**Abortion access is critical to women’s economic empowerment, and choosing our own reproductive futures is a fundamental right. I’m ready to do everything in my power to restore the right to legal, accessible abortion care in Congress.**

However, if we’re going to hold this district for Democrats, our campaign needs your continued support to stay competitive. = | **= Peter, this is a longer email, but it’s about life-changing decisions and I am sharing mine. When I became pregnant with my first child, my life changed. I was in the Army and in Company Command. I was stripped of command and advised to resign my career in military leadership - something I’d worked years to achieve. Kevin and I married, and I became a stay-at-home military spouse and mother. I gave up the life I had planned. In later jobs, I was hired at entry-level positions because I had taken “time off” to parent. As soon as I became a mother, I knew that my children would take priority in my life. Yet, as a mom of three, I also feel strongly that parenthood is something no one should be forced into against their will. Becoming a mother was the most defining moment of my life. That must be a personal decision. = Roe has fallen, but the attack on our rights has just begun. Without access to essential reproductive care, so many people who cannot afford to have another child, who didn’t plan on having children yet, or who never wanted to be parents will end up with altered lives. Women will carry this burden. Women will have to give up their jobs because they can’t afford childcare. Women will be tied down to abusive partners because of financial instability. Women will leave the workforce in droves. Women will feel these effects for the whole of their lives. The end of Roe v. Wade set our progress toward equality for women back by half a century. Fellow Conservative,

The Democrats spent four years trying to stop President Trump from getting anything accomplished for the American people. Now, President Biden is replicating the leadership style of Barack Obama: governing by executive order and strong-arming legislation through the House and Senate, in spite of having the narrowest majorities in DECADES.

**So much for working with Republicans in Congress.**

If we don't start building our coalition now, all bets are off for winning back control of the House this November. And honestly, America cannot afford two additional years of total Democrat control.

I’m writing today because we must start now to win a Conservative majority in Congress. **[We only need to win a FOUR seats to return a conservative majority to the House](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c39639%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=HaPviSaY2KTrS4JSa738Nw&sysid=1)**.

While the election may a couple of months away - **it’s imperative we’re able to begin the groundwork for a successful campaign cycle. TODAY.**

That's why before July 31st, **I’ve set a goal of identifying[10,000 conservatives](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c39630%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=%2b11FsiRt6uJOB%2fzgMvTTng&sysid=1) who stand ready and willing to help our team flip the House this November**.

**We have FIVE days until July 31st and so far have collected 3,500 signatures of the 10,000 signature goal, which means today we need 1,300 conservatives to step forward in order to stay on track toward meeting our goal by the end of the month **

[](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c39631%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=dwHvJTis1Aw6qXSkMDYvgA&sysid=1)

Retiring Nancy Pelosi as Speaker and uniting all Conservatives to stop radical legislation from Joe Biden and the far left begins today. **[We’re counting on you to join our cause.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c39632%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=xBSpxVoESPSbwKwz6sukkA&sysid=1)**

We hope you will be among the first to sign up and signal your commitment to return a Conservative majority in the House.

Thank you for your support.

For freedom,

subject: The Left's "Top Villain"
body:
To view this email as a web page, go to the link below, or copy and paste it into your browser's address window.
https://view.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=7cbfbd77dd780c8d55b9007855a5f02d43a1e5740c19bad0ee7e6451bc91ba7f0a08765ce2fb2dcfe703c89faf0b0d62620d987d6eea5103324978918e0243f03836d7fcf0ed8b981cf8e2e91d68c1a1

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=73bb1a04056b0f683c685808167d9fe77c06dfed8d11e7b46378349253bd7e5e6a0a824aeb2437fb576498831ce39049004199b1e9062802

Peter,

Did you see this article from
https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=73bb1a04056b0f68b79e26b17e3ef6984bbc42bd4cb40ad343c195b34119c254123180a5829c0738086c8a54fd3abb88b2e45d5790315e4c
The Washington Times ?

The title alone says a lot…

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=73bb1a04056b0f68b79e26b17e3ef6984bbc42bd4cb40ad343c195b34119c254123180a5829c0738086c8a54fd3abb88b2e45d5790315e4c

As you know, being a leader means taking a stand for what’s right even when the powerful are arrayed against you.

And there is no doubt the powerful are arrayed against me…
-
President Joe Biden is coming after me.
-
The full might of the Democrat Party is out to get me.
-
And Left-wing Democrat collaborators in Big Tech, Leftist media, and woke corporations are doing all they can to smear, censor, and destroy me personally and politically.
Florida Democrats, aligned with the dishonest corporate media and woke Hollywood Leftists, have ginned up phony hysteria to attack the Parental Rights in Education bill I signed into law. Even “family-friendly” companies are echoing the Democrats’ shameless propaganda.

The new law sensibly protects kindergarten through third graders against being indoctrinated with transgenderism and PG-13 rated lessons about sexuality. Either the Democrats and their corporate Left-wing allies are ignorant about the contents of the law because they didn’t bother reading the legislation and are only interested in spewing false talking points to smear me, OR they know full-well what’s in the bill and they truly believe five-year-olds should be taught gender identity curriculum… in their kindergarten classrooms!

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=73bb1a04056b0f683c685808167d9fe77c06dfed8d11e7b46378349253bd7e5e6a0a824aeb2437fb576498831ce39049004199b1e9062802
>>">Do you support parental rights in education?

Show your support HERE >>>

I will always fight back and do what’s best by standing for parents’ rights and protecting children here in Florida.

That’s why everyone from Hollywood to the Democrat National Committee is coming after me.

Peter, I’m reaching out to you today because without your help, the ridiculously false narratives they have been spreading about me will impact my re-election campaign.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=73bb1a04056b0f683c685808167d9fe77c06dfed8d11e7b46378349253bd7e5e6a0a824aeb2437fb576498831ce39049004199b1e9062802
I’m asking you to show your continued support by chipping in any amount now.

To fight back against the full might of Biden’s Democrat Party and their powerful Big Tech, Leftist media, and woke corporation collaborators, I must raise $3.6 million in the next 30 days.

To raise the full $3.6 million we’ve budgeted over the next 30 days, I simply have no choice but to turn to my supporters like you.

The Washington Times article I mentioned spells out just how determined the Democrats are to remove me from office.

“The Sun-Sentinel reported that Mr. DeSantis appears… as the top GOP villain…”

And why have I become the “top villain” to the Democrats?

They’re upset because I called out the Left-wing Democrats by saying they need to get out of their bubble and actually talk to parents like I have.

The overwhelming majority of parents don’t want this stuff in kindergarten, first grade, second grade, or third grade.

It doesn’t take a rocket scientist to understand that parents want to send their children to kindergarten to be educated without being exposed to sexualized curriculum.

We just want kids to be kids – not lab rats for woke social engineering.

The Hollywood elite disagree. That’s why Democrats are trying to shut me up and shut us down.

Peter, this brings me back to why I write to you today.

Florida is setting an unapologetic pro-freedom, pro-parental rights, child-focused example in education for other states to follow.

And Democrats can’t stand it!

NBC News went so far as to quote a Tallahassee insider saying: “DeSantis is just a different animal, and no one around here really knows how to deal with him because they know they’re going to get run over.”

Peter, I hope you will stand with me once again today.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=73bb1a04056b0f683c685808167d9fe77c06dfed8d11e7b46378349253bd7e5e6a0a824aeb2437fb576498831ce39049004199b1e9062802
[SHOW YOUR SUPPORT NOW]

We already know it’s going to be a brutal campaign, just like it was four years ago in 2018 when:
-
My race for Governor was decided by 32,463 votes, less than 0.5% of over 8 million votes cast!
-
My Democrat opponent raised and spent a staggering $52.5 million to beat me. And those were pre-Bidenflation dollars.It’s much higher now! The Democrats and the radical Left just can’t stomach a Governor who challenges them in anything they do.

>From opposing harmful lockdowns to opposing their attempts to indoctrinate kindergartners on sexuality, I continue to earn their ire.

And finally, let’s not forget how radical Democrats are allowing men to compete in WOMEN’S sports.

The fraud the NCAA is perpetuating on the American public is an absolute disgrace.

That’s why I issued a proclamation declaring the Sarasota native and female college swimmer as the “rightful winner” of the NCAA 500-meter freestyle – NOT the male swimmer from Penn.

Because here in Florida, science and facts matter.

I will not stand by and allow Leftists ideology to put wokeness ahead of fairness, indoctrination ahead of education, and hormone suppression ahead of biology.

In Florida, as long as I’m Governor, fair play in competition and fundamentals in education will remain intact.

These are just some of the reasons I have become the TOP TARGET of Joe Biden, national Democrats, and the woke corporate giants.

I’ll be the Left’s favorite punching bag through Election Day.

I’ll never back down. But I do need your help to win.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=73bb1a04056b0f683c685808167d9fe77c06dfed8d11e7b46378349253bd7e5e6a0a824aeb2437fb576498831ce39049004199b1e9062802
">Please help me stand strong against the radical Left’s attempts to infiltrate our firewall of freedom in Florida. Contribute NOW! >

Florida leads the way for the nation. That has been the case for the last two years. In fact, Florida has become…

First under attack. First blamed. First lied about.

Joe Biden knows my successful re-election as Governor of Florida will be yet another example of failure for the extremist Democrats! So please, renew your support today. I need it.

For Florida,

Ron DeSantis

P.S. Please read the linked
https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=73bb1a04056b0f68b79e26b17e3ef6984bbc42bd4cb40ad343c195b34119c254123180a5829c0738086c8a54fd3abb88b2e45d5790315e4c
Washington Times article entitled “Florida Democrats rally against Gov. DeSantis over parental rights legislation” and you will see why I need your help right away.

To fight back against the full might of Joe Biden’s Democrat Party and their powerful collaborators in Big Tech, Leftist media, and woke corporations, I simply must raise $3.6 million in the next 30 days.

That’s why I hope you will stand with me again today by supporting my re-election campaign.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=73bb1a04056b0f683c685808167d9fe77c06dfed8d11e7b46378349253bd7e5e6a0a824aeb2437fb576498831ce39049004199b1e9062802
DONATE NOW

name: Marco Rubio
subject: Humbly asking you to read this
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Marco Rubio for Senate
body:
I’d like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out. [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c612934%7c6283%7c6%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c1&wdmdk=l%2bq0wibn1oCf1%2fUXS2gVWA&sysid=1)
I’d like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out.

|
---
| | | Friend,

I’d like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out. I know I’ve been emailing, texting, and calling more than normal right now, but I need to reach my goal by midnight and need you to listen to me.

I hope you know me to be an honest man of integrity, so I thought I’d take a second to walk you through why I’m running for office and why this deadline means so much.

---
| [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64867%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=I%2fzbKu1qp9kd%2f0Rgew93kQ&sysid=1)
---

This is a photo of my dad (of course wearing a Miami Dolphins shirt). He was the best role model for being a father, a friend, and an American.

He and my mom thankfully came to America before the murderous dictator Fidel Castro came to power and turned Cuba to a dangerous socialist wasteland. After my parents saw what he had done to their homeland, they decided to stay put in America and get to work to achieve the American Dream.

---
| [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64867%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=I%2fzbKu1qp9kd%2f0Rgew93kQ&sysid=1)
---

Eventually, my sister and I became first generation college graduates, and while we had to take on student loans to do so, we knew the work ethic our parents instilled would help us pay them down once we graduated.

I met my wife Jeanette through mutual friends and we got married in 1998. We started our beautiful family of four kids: Amanda, Daniella, Anthony, and Dominick. We eventually adopted two dogs, Winston and Arthur (who I found with my laptop typing some emails to you recently...).

---
| [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64867%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=I%2fzbKu1qp9kd%2f0Rgew93kQ&sysid=1)
---

All jokes aside, being a father to my wonderful kids is by far my favorite and most important job, and I will never take that for granted.

I first ran for Senate because I saw what Barack Obama and Joe Biden’s policies were doing to families like mine. More families were living paycheck to paycheck at the expense of tax-and-spend Democrats. My parents taught me to work if I wanted to make a change, so that’s exactly what I did.

My dad never got to see me become a U.S. Senator in the country he immigrated to in order to make a better life for us, but I carry his work ethic and family values with me every day in the Senate to honor him, and now, I’m teaching my kids exactly what he taught me.

---
| [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64867%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=I%2fzbKu1qp9kd%2f0Rgew93kQ&sysid=1)
---

After seeing the dysfunction in Washington firsthand, I decided to run for President so I could bring my passion for America to the White House. My loving family was right by my side, and I couldn’t have been more grateful for their support.

I wanted to stop Hillary Clinton at all costs, and eventually, that meant dropping out of the race and working with Donald Trump to win. Throughout his term, we worked on pro-family and pro-veteran bills to make America great and restore the American Dream.

---
| [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64867%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=I%2fzbKu1qp9kd%2f0Rgew93kQ&sysid=1)
---

This brings me to my main point: I’m running for Senate because I will never stop fighting to restore the American Dream.

I feel so blessed looking through these photos, and I wanted to share them with you so you can understand where I am coming from.

Reaching these deadlines may seem like a fundraising ploy, but this is real. **If we’re outraised again, that will be a major step back in our fight to restore the American Dream.**
**[I hope you’ll make a donation today and join this fight before my deadline:](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64868%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=kTnQTzbciTxxE7bIcXNaBw&sysid=1)**
---
| | | [I'LL JOIN YOU, MARCO!](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64869%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=FmgwgnDCn%2bVf8M8lN0PskA&sysid=1)
---
Thank you so much for taking the time to read this,

Marco Rubio
---
| | | | |
* * *
---
| [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64860%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=niTY2ZJ%2buQmEhCun0Q0Isw&sysid=1)
---
I talk to folks every day who say they haven’t donated because they think they need to write a big check or they think my race isn’t close.

Well, let me tell you, this race will be decided on a razor-thin margin. Currently, we’re only separated by 2%, but considering the MILLIONS my opponent is raising, she could easily take the lead after smearing me in new campaign ads.

With such a tight race, any amount donated today can make a difference.

He and my mom thankfully came to America before the murderous dictator Fidel Castro came to power and turned Cuba to a dangerous socialist wasteland. After my parents saw what he had done to their homeland, they decided to stay put in America and get to work to achieve the American Dream. | Eventually, my sister and I became first generation college graduates, and while we had to take on student loans to do so, we knew the work ethic our parents instilled would help us pay them down once we graduated. I met my wife Jeanette through mutual friends and we got married in 1998. We started our beautiful family of four kids: Amanda, Daniella, Anthony, and Dominick. We eventually adopted two dogs, Winston and Arthur (who I found with my laptop typing some emails to you recently...). | All jokes aside, being a father to my wonderful kids is by far my favorite and most important job, and I will never take that for granted. I first ran for Senate because I saw what Barack Obama and Joe Biden’s policies were doing to families like mine. More families were living paycheck to paycheck at the expense of tax-and-spend Democrats. My parents taught me to work if I wanted to make a change, so that’s exactly what I did. My dad never got to see me become a U.S. Senator in the country he immigrated to in order to make a better life for us, but I carry his work ethic and family values with me every day in the Senate to honor him, and now, I’m teaching my kids exactly what he taught me. | After seeing the dysfunction in Washington firsthand, I decided to run for President so I could bring my passion for America to the White House. My loving family was right by my side, and I couldn’t have been more grateful for their support. I wanted to stop Hillary Clinton at all costs, and eventually, that meant dropping out of the race and working with Donald Trump to win. Throughout his term, we worked on pro-family and pro-veteran bills to make America great and restore the American Dream. | This brings me to my main point: I’m running for Senate because I will never stop fighting to restore the American Dream. I feel so blessed looking through these photos, and I wanted to share them with you so you can understand where I am coming from. Reaching these deadlines may seem like a fundraising ploy, but this is real. If we’re outraised again, that will be a major step back in our fight to restore the American Dream. | | | Thank you so much for taking the time to read this, Marco Rubio | | | | | | I talk to folks every day who say they haven’t donated because they think they need to write a big check or they think my race isn’t close. Well, let me tell you, this race will be decided on a razor-thin margin. Currently, we’re only separated by 2%, but considering the MILLIONS my opponent is raising, she could easily take the lead after smearing me in new campaign ads. With such a tight race, any amount donated today can make a difference. ** | | | | Paid for by Marco Rubio for Senate PO Box 530650 Miami, FL 33153 107 S West St. #826, Alexandria VA 22314

name: Deroy Murdock
subject: Survey on an urgent matter
body:
I hope your day is going well. I’m writing to let you know about something I think you’ll find useful in your learning.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zjk2krpcmtj8v1vv29hptdgujevjga9kog1bhrs0_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s3hm9oj4cdh238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq2d9ieuqfbdbie4rrcdljkorrbdt469r31d5jekrq9onicbq7bcpl68rrfc3mmtjjddhgcuqrcspgmhq74stn68onepr0c8rr6o9gcaqj1cr0sv970sj2cpob4pjgsipm6o3i61j7co5lmjjr5cb664ob4pj0s2qm6o70mkoj3d9hmlp2bs)
This sponsored message from Deroy Murdock is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zjf2ummn5lmgp28ua3kau02ah8ujdgc9b6o2877g_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s3hm9oj4cdh2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z1usl954ronnsir2150i3mbntbmsvr59t5d6o8g8_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s3hm9oj4cdh2bs)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zc8gk31164rt4din6gllq6o1n719i7mv2bpidjr8_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s3hm9oj4cdh2bs)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

body:
Will you help me FIRE Liz Cheney and take back our conservative movement from the elitist establishment that is working arm-in-a
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z2msf7j0g8ndm14sn1mffk0q6n4nq7q40mnhd018_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s3jm8o32cjh238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq8ddl69qbcd1jmgr32t5nmepradrmeej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hf9djm6lgj9d3jmqpn1p9jm5q7cdj5eeon4pb4coqmedjj6gqjep5i6krmac5h6srt4s3icgr31cj6e9q32tj0s2q6ac70mkom9pj6coored9kc1p72phkc2pm9ptgmlin49fg)
This will be the most important race in the entire country... |
Friend,

Will you help me FIRE Liz Cheney and take back our conservative movement from the elitist establishment that is working arm-in-arm with Joe Biden?

No sooner had President Trump endorsed my primary challenge to Liz Cheney did she shoot back with her usual arrogance to "bring it."

[**Well, I'm counting on you to help me bring it by chipping in with an emergency donation to my campaign to FIRE Liz Cheney.**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zqa2s5agb46v5etr0lqkjgvdvhe11judo445a4r0_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s3jm8o32cjh2bs) [DONATE NOW](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zirjjvk4bdnragudi093cd9bjt78rpte0auhhahg_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s3jm8o32cjh2bs)
You and I don't have a moment to lose...

That's because establishment elitists, like George W. Bush, headline ritzy fundraisers in other states to raise millions for Cheney.

That was even after Cheney admitted in a 60 Minutes interview that her record-breaking fundraising haul was helped out by Democrats.

If there was ever a time for conservative Americans to stand up to the elitist establishment, it's now. And it's against Liz Cheney.

[**Will you help me stand up with an urgently needed donation today?**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zrjct8jm49mi5l4fbqkrbhlfj813aa18m8sn7m70_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s3jm8o32cjh2bs)

I'm getting ahead of myself.

Before you decide to give to my campaign to FIRE establishment-anointed Liz Cheney from Congress, **let me tell you a little about who I am, why President Trump endorsed my primary challenge, and why we need your immediate help.**

My name is Harriet Hageman, and Wyoming is my home.

Growing up on a ranch outside Ft. Laramie, I learned the value of hard work, integrity, self-sufficiency, and honesty from an early age.

They're not just values Joe Biden and his socialists hate – they run absolutely counter to the establishment elites who have for too long controlled our Republican Party... and sold out our country to the highest bidder.

**I should know – like many in my state, and many more around the country, I was duped by these same "Republicans."**

**And as a constitutional lawyer who fought against Bill Clinton's EPA regulations, I watched in disgust as establishment elites like Liz Cheney embraced big government and abandoned our conservative values.**

Unfortunately, it's only gotten worse since President Trump left office.

And now, backed by their friends on the left and the media, Cheney and the establishment are waging a full-blown war on Americans like you and me!

[**No more. Will you support my campaign to defeat Liz Cheney by making an emergency donation today? I'll be honest, her LIBERAL big money backers are putting millions of dollars into her campaign right. Without your help, I don't stand a chance.**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2znrdmctsc4c4mne9ii2qj28t3e1j3489u426hmkg_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s3jm8o32cjh2bs) [DONATE NOW](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zbpnh5smppto8t2gmfv8iimd91pu43v2ki3etlu0_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s3jm8o32cjh2bs) As I said at the start of this email, **President Trump is 100% behind me.**

He knows the people of Wyoming – and the _American_ people - deserve better than Cheney, and he knows I'll never abandon our conservative values once elected to Congress.

In Wyoming, we have a long and proud history of standing up against an overbearing government.

In Washington, I promise to do the same...

...unlike Cheney, who spends more time fist-bumping Joe Biden and complimenting Nancy Pelosi than she does fighting back against big government bureaucrats who _waste our tax dollars_ , _fling open our borders_ , and _silence, censor, and even lock up conservatives_ who disagree!

**But even though I have President Trump's complete and total endorsement, there's one endorsement I still need: yours.**

[**Will you make an donation today to show President Trump that you're still a part of his MAGA-America First Movement?**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zd7l5e6uaeboekk49vq783odmt3o9r95outm1o38_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s3jm8o32cjh2bs) [DONATE NOW](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zf2eejnuoo3kumr8pb985613rqg0h35p12bg8sa0_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s3jm8o32cjh2bs) You should know that, even though polls show Cheney is grossly unpopular in Wyoming, she still thinks she can win re-election.

**In fact, when liberal _60 Minutes_ asked her if she could beat me in the primary, she said "absolutely...this is going to be the most important House race in the country."**

Well, she was right about something – this will be the most important race in the entire country – but only because it will be the first step in saving America from the big government elites who enable Joe Biden.

Again, I'll need your help to beat her.

As I said, Cheney can count on the deep pocketbooks of the entire establishment.

That's not even saying anything for her left-wing supporters, who see this as their chance to weaken our Republican Party for good.

**But with your help, I know we can beat them. And I know we can send the disastrous Cheney political dynasty packing for good.**

[**So please, won't you ensure that Liz Cheney bury me, a true conservative, with money from her swampy elite friends?**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z63odqtrurb5njjkro1g2hbqlsjrecko0suvv4gg_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s3jm8o32cjh2bs) [DONATE NOW](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zqjgg68lk39l5t72v7gh5auvf2h0d6assr0ors80_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s3jm8o32cjh2bs) Liz Cheney represents everything the left stands for, and everything we must fight against.

Will you help me make sure we win that fight?

Respectfully,
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zfh5lu158lfmpfpqdkoehjgml00umieo1j8gn9e8_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s3jm8o32cjh2bs)
Harriet Hageman
America First Conservative for Congress (WY)

P.S. It's disgusting to see Liz Cheney teaming up with George Bush to demonize conservatives and raise millions to back Nancy Pelosi's unconstitutional power grabs in Congress.

It's even more disgusting to watch her claim she speaks for the people of Wyoming and America.

[**No more – will you make an urgent donation to my campaign to defeat her in the Republican primary?**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zpbqdjck2p3qslbc94ic49g42rkom5k6gkg4ek28_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s3jm8o32cjh2bs) [DONATE NOW](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zjggj8977ollrt0esrcbq2ck4tgel60pa1ulmnbo_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s3jm8o32cjh2bs)

name: Chris Coulombe to Congress 2022
subject: Whatever Happens Next
body:
You’ll be among the first to know. Thank you for your support. I will never forget it.

| | [](http://avp.nationbuilder.com/?e=52bdf2ee8edf0eacfb7f7ef923d0ccf6&utm_source=avp&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=july_26&n=1)
---
**Dear Friend,** We received the certified primary election results from the Secretary of State, and I want to thank everyone for their support and effort over the last 3 months. The Chris To Congress team fought hard and we fought smart, out-raising all other challengers combined. We also matched the 18-month long campaign of the prevailing challenger almost vote for vote, falling short by only 0.3%. That a first-time candidate — not relying on the backing of party infrastructure but on the grassroots support of thousands of concerned citizens — came within a few hundred votes of advancing demonstrates the changing tide of our local and national politics. People are frustrated and they are ready for leaders who focus first and foremost on results. I launched this campaign out of a sense of duty. I could not sit by while people’s liberties, small businesses, and the middle class are crushed by what our Founders and many after them warned about: a coalition of government and corporations, beholden to the interests of elected officials, bureaucrats, and CEOs; callous to the people’s needs. Needs like water, fire safety, and access to world-class education, which every child in this country deserves as a birthright of being American. The challenges I addressed over the past 3 months are challenges that I believe must be confronted whether or not I am in office. Among the many issues I raised, all presently pale in comparison to the prospect of severe water shortages. Please continue to spread the word about the removal of freshwater storage in our region, which some of our political leaders support, indefensibly. The arrogance and hubris of removing the public’s access to fresh water will result in a humanitarian disaster that is beyond description. We must do everything we can to ensure continued access to abundant supplies of water. Please continue to encourage and provide financial support for the county farm bureaus and other organizations that are fighting to protect our critical infrastructure and our future. What’s next for me? I plan to take the next few months to spend much-needed time with my family, friends, and dog Xorro. Then I will assess with my team how I can best serve the North Coast over the coming years, both politically and economically. I put my business on hold for most of this year. I will resume growing my company and supporting the small businesses of California. I also feel that politics is where I can make the biggest contribution to creating a better world. Whatever I decide to do next, you’ll be among the first to know. Thank you for your support. I will never forget it. Semper Fidelis,
**Chris** [](https://avp.nationbuilder.com/christocongress?e=52bdf2ee8edf0eacfb7f7ef923d0ccf6&utm_source=avp&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=july_26&n=2)
---

name: Trudy Busch Valentine
subject: running for Senate was never part of my plan
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Trudy Busch Valentine for Senate
body:
But now, I'm called to service once again.
| | |
---
Peter,

Making the decision to run for Senate wasn't easy. I was trained to be a nurse: to care for patients, to comfort families through difficult moments, and to treat sickness with compassion and honesty. Serving as a nurse was my dream for as long as I can remember.
**Running for office or walking the halls of Congress was never part of my plan by any stretch of the imagination.** A nurse has never served in the Senate – and I certainly had no intentions of trying to be the first. But life doesn't always go as planned.
You see, what I've realized is that my calling doesn’t end with being a nurse; my calling is to serve those around me as best I can, however I can. I've dedicated myself to service: as a nurse, a volunteer, a children's advocate, and a loving mother.**And now, as I watch partisanship and extremism threaten to divide our country, I'm called to service once again.**
The same skills and values that were instilled in me as a nurse – problem solving, people-first leadership, compassion, and integrity – are exactly what Washington needs right now.
As your next senator, I promise to always serve your interests and put your family first. I promise to never sell out to corporate lobbyists or partisanship. I promise to boldly take on the big issues that are plaguing our country, like gun violence, the opioid epidemic, or the rising costs of living. I promise to bring empathy, kindness, and honesty to Congress.
**Washington has had lawyers and lobbyists running things for far too long. The system is broken, and a nurse's heart and mind are the cure it needs. [If you agree with me, can you donate $5 now to power my grassroots campaign? Bringing about big change doesn't happen overnight. Wade , Democrats in the U.S. House moved quickly to pass the Respect for Marriage Act — legislation that protects the right to same-sex and interracial marriage for all Americans. But now the bill is stalling. Senate Democrats are struggling to find 10 Republicans who would vote yes and “filibuster-proof” marriage equality protections. Yes, it’s really that absurd. In the year 2022, an archaic, Jim Crow era rule is stopping us from codifying the fundamental right to marry who you love! And the same goes for protecting voting rights and reproductive rights. At the center of this mess is — you guessed it — Kyrsten Sinema, who STILL sides with Republicans on keeping the filibuster, no matter the cost. Recent years have shown that Sinema isn’t motivated by things like the pleas of her colleagues, the majority opinion of her constituents, or simply doing what’s right. body:
Hi Peter,

When my husband, Hung Cao, announced his run for Congress in VA-10, politics seemed like a crude reality of life; that is not the case. We’ve been blessed with a warm outpouring of support and generosity, the likes of which we never could have imagined.

In just five short months since announcing his run for Congress he’s raised a total of **$982,756**!

The political elite may not have believed in him, Peter. But I always did.

I see every day what a great man he is. From serving in the Navy for over 25 years to staying up from dawn to dusk talking to hardworking Virginians, he’s always been on your side, and he’ll stop at nothing to make our district - and our country - as strong as it can be.

I’ll be honest, Peter - just because we’ve come so far doesn't mean this race is going to be easy.

With Democrat mega-donors laser focused on Virginia, the odds are stacked against us.

But with you on our team, I know we can pull off an incredible victory and take back the House for families like ours.

I hope you’ll be a part of our incredible journey. I know it’s the honor of my husband’s lifetime, and it’s the honor of mine too.

| BIG update: **_FiveThirtyEight_ just ranked Ohio's Senate race as a "toss-up."**

I know you probably get plenty of fundraising emails from campaigns like mine. I'm sure they can clutter your inbox and, frankly, be a bit annoying, but the fact of the matter is that they make up a large portion of our grassroots fundraising.
Emails like this one help me connect with my supporters, reach every Granite Stater, and get grassroots donations in the door. Every online donation makes a huge impact in a race this competitive.
We’re fighting an uphill battle here in the Granite State. Republicans are specifically targeting this seat, spending more than $21 million against me because they know that in 2016 I won by just 1,017 votes. I say all this not to scare you, but to help you understand the stakes of this election, because they are high. Every dollar you give helps us fight back, turn out voters, and secure this seat and our Senate majority.
**[So it would mean a lot to me if you would chip in $3, or whatever you can, to help us win this seat in November.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48360310/357935598/-947982778?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&amount=3&refcode=mh-jtk1327-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4Yjk4MmMyYS0zMzBkLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=iR5p3ag_a8zXlH3nHUbhOh7HmzxTY0kzmt541dTuHzw=)**
But I also want you to know that if you can't donate today, that's ok. Just the fact that you are reading this email means a lot to me – regardless of whether or not you choose to donate.
With less than 4 months until Election Day, our campaign’s biggest challenges lie ahead of us, so I will continue to call on you for your support. When you can, I hope you will donate, but when you can’t, please know that looking out for opportunities to volunteer or simply to stay updated on this race by reading these emails helps strengthen our team.
No matter what your support looks like folks, I am beyond grateful to have it. Thank you for being on my team.
With every good wish,
Maggie Hassan

### _Thank You for Attending_
---
|
---
| Thank you to everyone who attended and contributed to our event last week at the **Buckhead City Headquarters**. The Buckhead City movement is very much alive and well, and we look forward to our right to vote in 2023. I want to make sure that not only Buckhead is well protected with police, but also all of greater Atlanta once I am elected.
_**My plan for reducing the crime:**_

**1.** Fully fund our police departments
**2.** Hire more police officers
**3.** Increase salaries for officers and 911 operators
**4.** Show our appreciation for law enforcement
If you were unable to attend, please consider making a $100 donation at www.christianzimm.com/donate.

We need to get the word out about our campaign, please forward this email to 10 of your friends to help grow our campaign!

🚨 Breaking: Jake LaTurner Endorsed by the Kansas Livestock Association! | |

| | | **ENDORSED: Kansas Livestock Association ✅**

---
| Friend,

**It is my honor to share with you that the _Kansas Livestock Association_ has officially endorsed my campaign for re-election to Kansas' Second Congressional District. **

As a 6th-generation Kansan, I am proud of our ranching heritage in Kansas. Under Joe Biden, farmers and ranchers across America have been fighting each and every day to stay afloat and make ends meet. Supply chain disruptions, soaring gas and input costs, and historic inflation are crippling rural America. Enough is enough. I am fighting to get our nation back on track and provide relief to our agriculture community.

**I will ALWAYS stand up for issues that impact rural communities, be a loud voice for the thousands of family farms throughout our state, and defend our shared values and beliefs. **

Dear Fellow American, A few years ago, _New York_ magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?” This is, of course, an exaggeration. But it makes clear that the far-Left in America aims to bring about a “Great Reset” of our economy and our way of life. In a recent issue of _Imprimis_ —Hillsdale College’s digest of liberty—author Michael Rectenwald described the economic goal of the Great Reset as “‘capitalism with Chinese characteristics’—a two-tiered economy, with profitable monopolies and the state on top and socialism for the majority below.” Today, as a supporter of liberty, you can help Hillsdale College understand the extent of support for—and opposition to—socialism. Your input will help us develop the most effective strategy to fight for the future of liberty in our country. **Will you please share your views on the political, social, and cultural forces promoting socialism in our country by completing your National Survey on Socialism using the secure link below?** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zrgauql703t84u4kvp8qt7dfk614obl0go39qjig_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s3jm6ob4c1h2bs)** Sadly, socialism is becoming increasingly popular, especially among the young. You may be aware of a SHOCKING survey showing that... **. . . during the COVID-19 pandemic, support for socialism among those 16 to 23 years old jumped to 49 percent, and socialism also increased in popularity among all ages.** **Why is this?** Draconian government lockdown measures destroyed businesses and eliminated competitors of corporate monopolists. These policies were a dream come true for corporate socialists. At the same time, too many young Americans have not been taught what socialism really means. Or the dismal history of its failures wherever it has been tried. This is a result of the far-Left’s “long march through the institutions”—including colleges and universities, K-12 schools, and the media. Marxist-inspired critical race theory is a prime example. Once confined to the classrooms of far-Left professors, critical race theory has infiltrated every level of government, as well as school boards and even the military. But it is in our schools where the effects of critical race theory—which teaches young Americans to categorize their fellow citizens according to race—are most dangerous. You may recall that many young Americans with college degrees who championed socialist policies participated in the riots and violence we witnessed in the summer of 2020. In the face of well-financed and widespread efforts to destroy free markets and individual liberty, Hillsdale’s work to **reach** and **teach** millions has never been more urgently needed. **That’s why I need your thoughts quickly.** By responding to the **National Survey on Socialism** in the next five days**,** your honest opinions will help us understand the recent rise of socialism and develop our strategy to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. We hope to hear from friends representing every part of the country. Education is the surest way to turn back this dangerous trend. And your partnership with Hillsdale College is critical. As Winston Churchill said, “Socialism is the philosophy of failure, the creed of ignorance, and the gospel of envy.” If you agree, please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Socialism** today. **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zm47j8123u2qmlirlqkoaa9gobo9pl4j4ilt1jm0_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s3jm6ob4c1h2bs)** Despite the recent successes of the far-Left, we must remember—**it is NEVER too late to defend liberty through education**. But it makes clear that the far-Left in America aims to bring about a “Great Reset” of our economy and our way of life. In a recent issue of Imprimis —Hillsdale College’s digest of liberty—author Michael Rectenwald described the economic goal of the Great Reset as “‘capitalism with Chinese characteristics’—a two-tiered economy, with profitable monopolies and the state on top and socialism for the majority below.” Today, as a supporter of liberty, you can help Hillsdale College understand the extent of support for—and opposition to—socialism. Your input will help us develop the most effective strategy to fight for the future of liberty in our country. Will you please share your views on the political, social, and cultural forces promoting socialism in our country by completing your National Survey on Socialism using the secure link below? Sadly, socialism is becoming increasingly popular, especially among the young. You may be aware of a SHOCKING survey showing that... . . . during the COVID-19 pandemic, support for socialism among those 16 to 23 years old jumped to 49 percent, and socialism also increased in popularity among all ages. Why is this? Draconian government lockdown measures destroyed businesses and eliminated competitors of corporate monopolists. These policies were a dream come true for corporate socialists. At the same time, too many young Americans have not been taught what socialism really means. Or the dismal history of its failures wherever it has been tried. This is a result of the far-Left’s “long march through the institutions”—including colleges and universities, K-12 schools, and the media. Marxist-inspired critical race theory is a prime example. Once confined to the classrooms of far-Left professors, critical race theory has infiltrated every level of government, as well as school boards and even the military. But it is in our schools where the effects of critical race theory—which teaches young Americans to categorize their fellow citizens according to race—are most dangerous. You may recall that many young Americans with college degrees who championed socialist policies participated in the riots and violence we witnessed in the summer of 2020. In the face of well-financed and widespread efforts to destroy free markets and individual liberty, Hillsdale’s work to reach and teach millions has never been more urgently needed. That’s why I need your thoughts quickly. By responding to the National Survey on Socialism in the next five days, your honest opinions will help us understand the recent rise of socialism and develop our strategy to reach and teach increasing millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. We hope to hear from friends representing every part of the country. Education is the surest way to turn back this dangerous trend. And your partnership with Hillsdale College is critical. As Winston Churchill said, “Socialism is the philosophy of failure, the creed of ignorance, and the gospel of envy.” If you agree, please represent your state and take the National Survey on Socialism today. | Arizona is at a crossroads. We can continue down the path of open borders, government overreach, and lawlessness or we can choose a candidate who will finally secure the border and uphold the rule of law. It’s decision time. **I’m the right choice for Attorney General.** A vote for me is a vote to... **SECURE THE BORDER** : When it comes to border security, I alone among the candidates have skin in the game. As Attorney General, I’ll have one thing to say to illegal border crossers, smugglers, traffickers, and cartels: _I don’t care where you go, but you’re not passing through Arizona._ Other politicians continue to bluster about the border. But for me, the border isn’t just a talking point —it’s personal. I want to solve this persistent problem once and for all. But until border security becomes a personal problem for other politicians, they will never do more than talk. Their “solutions” will never make it off the campaign trail. I intend to use every power available to me as Attorney General to keep this hell out of our backyard. **RESTORE CONFIDENCE IN OUR ELECTIONS** : Politicians have trivialized election integrity—like so many other crucial issues—to just another campaign talking point. But when you’ve seen election manipulation, fraud and incompetence with your own eyes—it’s happening again in Pinal County as I speak!—you know we must prioritize solutions now. As Attorney General, I will prosecute everyone who violates our election integrity laws. I’ll push for new legislation that makes it harder to cheat. And I’ll follow through on any outstanding investigations into the 2020 election. I promise to prioritize election integrity. After all, other rights seem pretty meaningless without the right to vote. _Speaking of voting, the time has come for you to exercise your voting rights!_ As you weigh your ballot options, don’t just take my word that I’m best suited for the job. body:
budget cuts could cost us this race and our opportunity to expand our Senate majority
| | |
---
My finance director told me this morning that I'm WAY behind on my midnight fundraising goal. We're running out of time to reach that goal, and **I'm worried we have to make some tough decisions about our budget to mobilize voters and fight back against Rubio's deceitful attack ads. **
Does this worry me, friend? _Absolutely._ I just ran my FIRST TV ad of the election cycle to counter Marco Rubio's lies about my law enforcement service. The TV ads cost me an arm and a leg – but it was a necessary risk if we want to flip Florida blue. I never anticipated donations to plummet over the past few days, when this team has had my back _from day one_.

Democrats Serve is a national organization that helps Democratic candidates with public service backgrounds — including first responders, firefighters, social workers, police officers, prosecutors, judges, public defenders, educators, and more — run for office and win elections.
Democratic candidates with public service backgrounds have a pragmatic approach to governing and know how to get things done, making for strong campaign narratives and an ability to connect with voters uniquely. | | Workers are the heart of the economy. It is workers who move goods and provide services. And workers create jobs by spending their wages. So when I get asked by voters how we can fix the economy, my answer is simple: **put workers first.** Since President Biden has taken office, putting working families first is exactly what Democrats have done. **We passed the American Rescue Plan** , which put money directly into the hands of workers and small businesses owners. **We passed the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law** , which invested $550 billion of new spending on critical infrastructure projects across the country. Americans will be put to work repairing roads and bridges while also updating the power grid and providing broadband internet access. **We brought historically low unemployment and stronger growth than China ****for the first time in nearly five decades to an economy that had lost 20 million jobs.** But there is still work to do. **Workers have not received a real raise in years**. That is why my Democratic colleagues and I support a $15 federal minimum wage. **The pandemic laid bare and made worse the glaring gaps in child care, housing, and medical costs.** That is why my Democratic colleagues and I support expanding access to child care, guaranteeing equal pay for women, and combating the rising cost of prescription drugs. Like I said: it sounds simple. Yet Republicans do not agree. This is why the upcoming election is so critical. **When faced with reasonable efforts to lower prescription drug prices, make child care more affordable, and manage the rising costs of housing, gas, and basic essentials like baby formula, my Democratic colleagues and I voted yes and all but a handful of Republicans voted no. Right down the line, no, no, and no.** I am asking for your vote to continue putting working families first. clean_body: | | | | Workers are the heart of the economy. It is workers who move goods and provide services. And workers create jobs by spending their wages. So when I get asked by voters how we can fix the economy, my answer is simple: put workers first. Since President Biden has taken office, putting working families first is exactly what Democrats have done. We passed the American Rescue Plan , which put money directly into the hands of workers and small businesses owners. We passed the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law , which invested $550 billion of new spending on critical infrastructure projects across the country. Americans will be put to work repairing roads and bridges while also updating the power grid and providing broadband internet access. We brought historically low unemployment and stronger growth than China for the first time in nearly five decades to an economy that had lost 20 million jobs. But there is still work to do. Workers have not received a real raise in years. That is why my Democratic colleagues and I support a $15 federal minimum wage. The pandemic laid bare and made worse the glaring gaps in child care, housing, and medical costs. That is why my Democratic colleagues and I support expanding access to child care, guaranteeing equal pay for women, and combating the rising cost of prescription drugs. Like I said: it sounds simple. Yet Republicans do not agree. This is why the upcoming election is so critical. When faced with reasonable efforts to lower prescription drug prices, make child care more affordable, and manage the rising costs of housing, gas, and basic essentials like baby formula, my Democratic colleagues and I voted yes and all but a handful of Republicans voted no. Right down the line, no, no, and no. I am asking for your vote to continue putting working families first. It is the question facing voters this election, and the choice could not be clearer. | | | **_Learn More About Chuck_**

---
---
| | | Family, hard work and community. These are the things that have defined me as a person more than anything else and are the things that make New Hampshire a special place. Several local Salem community leaders became role models and mentors and got me involved with helping our community. With their encouragement, I ran for Salem Selectman and won. I ran for Town Moderator and won. Then I ran for State Representative and served for two terms from 1998-2002. I was elected to the State Senate in 2002 and was appointed to the Finance Committee. My experience running a business, meeting a payroll, and keeping a conservative budget helped prepare me for the challenges of crafting a balanced state budget. I quickly became known as one of the state’s leaders in budgeting and tax policy. I took a step back from politics in 2006. My daughter was starting her junior year in high school and Susan and I spent most of the next few years traveling to her field hockey and basketball games. We were her biggest fans. In 2010, I was reelected to the Senate. When I returned to the Finance Committee, I found the financial mess that the Democrats had put our state in. The state had an $800 million deficit. We quickly turned that around and put the state’s finances back on a sustainable path. For my work, colleagues gave me the greatest honor of my life — electing me the Senate President in 2013. In 2020, I led Republican efforts to retake the majority in the State Senate. New Hampshire was the only state in the country that was able to flip a blue state legislature to red and it was largely due to our strong fight against the Democrats’ proposed state income tax. Last year, we passed one of the most conservative and fiscally responsible budgets that New Hampshire has ever seen. It is balanced, cuts taxes for small businesses, provides more than $300 million in property tax relief, bans late-term abortions, and prohibits the use of discriminatory teaching in our schools. It puts New Hampshire on a path to long-term prosperity. The work ethic, commitment to family and sense of community that I learned at a young age have stuck with me as an adult and drive everything I do. I still wake up at 4am every morning to work at our business before going to Concord to do the people’s business. More often than not, I still take my first phone calls of the day while driving a tractor. Washington, D.C. has enough silver-spoon, Ivy League lawyers. I believe that I am a product of all the best parts of New Hampshire — the spirit of freedom, sense of volunteerism and responsibility of giving back to the community that has helped shape me into the person I am today. I want to bring New Hampshire to Washington and makes sure our voices are heard. I want to bring New Hampshire values to a place that needs them now more than ever. I want to work for you and I hope you will consider electing me to represent you in the U.S. Senate.

New Hampshire was the only state in the country that was able to flip a blue state legislature to red and it was largely due to our strong fight against the Democrats’ proposed state income tax. Last year, we passed one of the most conservative and fiscally responsible budgets that New Hampshire has ever seen. It is balanced, cuts taxes for small businesses, provides more than $300 million in property tax relief, bans late-term abortions, and prohibits the use of discriminatory teaching in our schools. It puts New Hampshire on a path to long-term prosperity. The work ethic, commitment to family and sense of community that I learned at a young age have stuck with me as an adult and drive everything I do. I still wake up at 4am every morning to work at our business before going to Concord to do the people’s business. More often than not, I still take my first phone calls of the day while driving a tractor. Washington, D.C. has enough silver-spoon, Ivy League lawyers. I believe that I am a product of all the best parts of New Hampshire — the spirit of freedom, sense of volunteerism and responsibility of giving back to the community that has helped shape me into the person I am today. I want to bring New Hampshire to Washington and makes sure our voices are heard. I want to bring New Hampshire values to a place that needs them now more than ever. Fellow American,

You may or may not watch “**The View** ,” but undoubtedly, you’ve heard of the daytime talk show owing to the many ludicrous things their hosts have said throughout the years. Let me remind you of a few examples:

“ _**If you kick out all of the Latinos who’s going to clean your toilets?**_ ” – Kelly Osbourn on illegal immigration

“ _**It was a Halloween party. I went as a beautiful African woman.**_ ” – Joy Behar on wearing blackface to a Halloween party

Fellow American, my name is Rod Dorilás and I’m not an oxymoron. I’m a trained lawyer, military veteran, 1st generation American and **proud Black Republican**. Peter,

You may or may not watch “**The View** ,” but undoubtedly, you’ve heard of the daytime talk show owing to the many ludicrous things their hosts have said throughout the years. Let me remind you of a few examples:

“ _**If you kick out all of the Latinos who’s going to clean your toilets?**_ ” – Kelly Osbourn on illegal immigration

“ _**It was a Halloween party. I went as a beautiful African woman.**_ ” – Joy Behar on wearing blackface to a Halloween party

body:
Dear friend,

Joe Biden betrayed my son.

Chad was a U.S. Marshal defending the Federal Courthouse in Portland, Oregon, during the violent summer riots of 2020.

But instead of rewarding Chad for bravely putting his life on the line to protect life and property, the Biden administration is allowing his life to be destroyed.

clean_body: | | | We can’t let them take control of Congress | | | Team, Last week, while Donald Trump and Mike Pence brought their shadow battle for the GOP directly to Arizona, the AZ GOP members of Congress were again showing just how extreme they are. Every member of the AZ GOP’s congressional delegation voted against protecting same-sex marriage, interracial marriage and the right for people to have access to contraceptives. It’s another reminder that if the GOP grabs control of Congress, they will pursue an agenda that is absolutely too extreme for Arizona. And as the top toss-up state, control of Congress is likely to come down to whether we can protect our current Democratic seats here in Arizona. We’ve often pointed out that the AZ GOP wants to send us back decades. Refusing to support federal protections for same-sex marriage, interracial marriage and access to contraceptives is just the latest proof of the AZ GOP’s backward agenda. Add in their other backward, extreme positions – on voting rights, on abortion, and more – and you can see how disastrous giving Republicans control of Congress would be. We can’t let them roll back our rights. We have to protect our Congressional majorities, which means we have to protect our seats here in Arizona. | | Friends,

Last month our campaign was named as an official NRCC Young Gun, and this month we got even more good news: _The Hill_ named our race as one of the seven closest races that could decide control of the House, and then _Fox News_ moved our race rating to **LEANS Republican**.

Our campaign (and the summer weather) is heating up, and we're excited we have all the momentum on our side. But we can't take our foot off the gas if we want to win this November and flip PA-17 from blue-to-red.

To keep up the momentum, Jeremy is staying very active on the campaign trail \- marching in parades, running in 5k's, attending community days, hosting meet & greets, and more! One of our top performing social media posts this month was Jeremy, while in front of the Beaver County cracker plant, [recording a video](https://JeremyShaffer.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=168b3aab49521aba8263d07fe&id=cd3e896b6e&e=32107e7cf1) inviting Joe Biden to visit Western PA:

The budget fulfills three major priorities: reducing the cost of everyday expenses, funding essential services, and improving our state's fiscal health. I'll run through each one by one.
1. **Providing meaningful tax relief**
More money in your pocket, more food in the fridge, more gas in the tank — it's as simple as that. The budget does this through the Illinois Family Relief Plan, which consists of $1.83 billion in tax savings from:
* Eliminating the state tax on groceries
* Suspending the gas tax
* Providing property tax rebates of up to $300 per household
* Permanently expanding the earned income tax credit
* Slashing the sales tax on school supplies for ten days
* Sending direct checks to 6.2 million taxpayers
2. **Funding government services**
We're making record investments to modernize our schools, improve services for working families, and keep communities safe.
_After all, working families deserve a government that works for them._
Of course, we're also continuing to strengthen our health care system, empower small businesses, rebuild our infrastructure, and build a clean energy economy.
3. **Getting our fiscal house in order**
Republicans love to _talk_ about fiscal responsibility, but Democrats under my administration have actually _delivered_ it.
After twenty years of decline, credit rating agencies have now upgraded our credit rating six times since I took office. Our bill backlog is fully paid off. Our pension liabilities are reduced. And we've now dedicated a healthy $1 billion to our rainy day fund to help Illinoisans during future economic downturns.

All told, this budget is going to improve the lives of so many people who are feeling stretched thin. clean_body: Hi there, friend — Our fourth balanced budget recently took effect and it's a game-changer for Illinois, delivering $1.83 billion in tax relief for working people. I'm going to lay everything out in detail, but if you don't mind, will you what spending less on property taxes, groceries, and gasoline would mean to your family right now? | Prefer writing your answer? to submit using a form instead. The budget fulfills three major priorities: reducing the cost of everyday expenses, funding essential services, and improving our state's fiscal health. I'll run through each one by one. 1. Providing meaningful tax relief More money in your pocket, more food in the fridge, more gas in the tank — it's as simple as that. The budget does this through the Illinois Family Relief Plan, which consists of $1.83 billion in tax savings from: Eliminating the state tax on groceries Suspending the gas tax Providing property tax rebates of up to $300 per household Permanently expanding the earned income tax credit Slashing the sales tax on school supplies for ten days Sending direct checks to 6.2 million taxpayers 2. Funding government services We're making record investments to modernize our schools, improve services for working families, and keep communities safe. After all, working families deserve a government that works for them. Of course, we're also continuing to strengthen our health care system, empower small businesses, rebuild our infrastructure, and build a clean energy economy. 3. Getting our fiscal house in order Republicans love to talk about fiscal responsibility, but Democrats under my administration have actually delivered it. After twenty years of decline, credit rating agencies have now upgraded our credit rating six times since I took office. Our bill backlog is fully paid off. Our pension liabilities are reduced. And we've now dedicated a healthy $1 billion to our rainy day fund to help Illinoisans during future economic downturns. All told, this budget is going to improve the lives of so many people who are feeling stretched thin. Now, if you're still with me, I'm asking you to fill me in on your situation. | | **ICYMI: Competitive tax climate would help Kansas attract a skilled workforce and keep retired residents

** **By Dan Hawkins, Kansas House Majority Leader
**[**_July 15, 2022, The Topeka Capital-Journal._**](http://links.schmidtforkansas.com/u/click?_t=4eb8bd5dcca54a0b993a2eb1eb42ba73&_m=5952dab451164ac5a978ab86c9bc2fd4&_e=WcBw4c7uWAGuCjp1D5ARXNmaVzl6vQdZbNPGb3O1Gx7pIKT4X9bURoQX6eLBM__QmDEDESGqotHQ3M8wB8T4VI7txzFFW_ChkRl1q4qEqcojoCYrWqg_lXjNKMcXvv7dheoW9-Oaa61O13_lWJFubSFRNMKT0T_Tl-LVE8wodlInzZEfUP4oB7wqBzZ_iQwls2FylilDIsjEsIXXJh_f0bNZExrYFYIUlZDS0ud-9Qm4WCzEhH15Wc2I8mhVawMNh8k7pOkgSCVeneTt4A03WKBc7zNSMXKBgF1afguJ-4e_XdaRnZWjV9wW_ksKys1RhctGSYoxhHRTONdrhudsNjszuYrLhN7V_501Z4ZXtS5-E4PstfzzpOJ2Nsk0eMGlXUrKHafoQ-9evAknIZ5auA%3D%3D)

When you’ve spent your life working hard, raising a family, and saving money, you should never be prevented from fulfilling dreams to travel, visit grandkids and make up for lost time.

It’s a tragedy to reach that point only to find you can’t do those things because your retirement account is depleted due to an unstable market, the cost of gas has reached record highs, and the cost of living is increasing at a rate not seen in over four decades.

Sadly, retirees living in Kansas do not have to imagine this scenario. They are living it.

Because of the policy whims of elected officials like President Joe Biden and Gov. Laura Kelly, we are experiencing record inflation and gas prices. All Kansans are struggling to make ends meet, especially retirees on a fixed income. To make matters worse, an independent analysis recently rated Kansas as the third-worst state in the country for tax burden on retirees.

Thankfully there’s hope on the horizon. Kansas attorney general and Republican candidate for governor Derek Schmidt has a plan to improve these dismal numbers. Derek’s “Retire Tax Free” initiative would ensure there is no income tax on social security benefits, no income tax on pensions, and no income tax on 401k’s and IRA’s.

Removing the tax on retirement benefits makes good economic sense. There are currently 12 states nationwide that do not tax retirement income, and Iowa soon joining the list. For Kansas to compete with these states to attract a skilled workforce and retain retirees, we must have a competitive tax climate. Schmidt’s Retire Tax Free plan goes a long way toward making that happen.

Meanwhile, Gov. Kelly’s Tax Council this year endorsed a plan that would actually raise taxes on retirees and other Kansans earning more than $50,000 per year.

With the obscenely high tax burden on retirees, it’s no wonder that Kansas ranks high in outbound migration. Kansas is a great state to live and raise a family. It also should be a great state to retire.

After a lifetime of service in their local communities, it’s a shame that retirees are forced to leave our state for financial reasons. It’s unfair to retirees, and it’s unfair to the rest of us. We need their civic involvement, knowledge, and talent. I look forward to working with Attorney General Schmidt to implement the Retire Tax Free plan, lower the overall tax burden, and ensure all Kansans get to keep more of their hard-earned money.

Peter,

You may or may not watch “**The View** ,” but undoubtedly, you’ve heard of the daytime talk show owing to the many ludicrous things their hosts have said throughout the years. Let me remind you of a few examples:

“ _**If you kick out all of the Latinos who’s going to clean your toilets?**_ ” – Kelly Osbourn on illegal immigration

“ _**It was a Halloween party. I went as a beautiful African woman.**_ ” – Joy Behar on wearing blackface to a Halloween party

Or when Whoopie Goldberg last year had this to say when talking about the Holocaust: “ _**Well, this is white people doing it to white people. So, this is y’all go fight amongst yourselves.**_ ”

Well, now things have gotten political once again. Recently co-host Sunny Hostin said on air that she “ _**doesn’t understand black Republicans,**_ ” and that a black Republican is “ _**an oxymoron**_.”

It’s been a busy few weeks in the House. Even before the Supreme Court’s decision overturning Roe v. July 20, 2022

July 22, 2022
Since the Supreme Court’s Roe decision, we’ve seen real threats to our most fundamental freedoms.
In Texas, extreme lawmakers are threatening to introduce legislation that would walk back people’s right to travel across state lines for abortion care. And Texas’ attorney general filed a lawsuit to block President Biden’s executive order protecting access to abortion in medical emergencies.
The threats are real. And Lizzie is taking action in Congress to address them.
Lizzie also continues to deliver on other promises she’s made since 2018, like helping bring federal dollars home to mitigate flooding:

Dozens of homes in Jersey Village have suffered from repeat flooding, but this summer, a project will begin to replace water and storm sewer lines to reduce flooding in the area. Lizzie fought for the funding to get this project off the ground and seeing it come to fruition is a great example of what we can get done when we work together to address our shared challenges.

Instead, he sits around all day pitching himself to get on TV, where he calls Arizona Attorney General Mark Brnovich — who has been endorsed by Mark Levin and Sean Hannity — a 'do-nothing RINO.'" **In Dinesh D’Souza’s new movie 2,000 Mules he uncovers how Mules stole the election from President Trump.

I know and understand that election integrity is the critical issue of our time.

The left and RINOS want us to stop talking about the stolen election so they can do it again! We all know if we don’t have fair elections, we don’t have a country.

Election integrity is the single most important issue facing America today. It is a FACT that the election was STOLEN from our rightful President Donald J. Trump.

But as usual the weak GOP has let the country down and allowed globalist and mules to steal the election.** [**Unlike them, I HAVE YOU! Because of the stolen election we have an illegitimate President who has destroyed America. We have record high gas and food prices. Plus, we just sent 40 billion to Ukraine when we have homeless veterans on the streets of America!

This midterm is the most important of our lifetime, and if we don’t elect strong pro Trump Patriots focused on election integrity, 2022 could be the last election in American history.

It’s easy to get discouraged in dark times like this, but the good news is Patriots around the country are rallying around my grassroots campaign!

Every metric from social media, to polling shows my campaign is doing well and we are resonating with people across the country. When I get to Congress, I’ll be the number one fighter for fixing our broken election system and will be an ULTRA MAGA Pro Trump congressman 100% of the time with ZERO COMPROMISE.

My opponent may have globalist billionaires supporting them, but I HAVE THE AMERICAN PEOPLE SUPPORTING ME. Only with your help can we carry out President Trump’s vision and MAKE AMERICA GREAT AGAIN. I need you and I need you today! Let's win this together! Donate below!I**

Peter,
I'm truly grateful for staunch allies like you.
_**It wouldn 't be right to go another day without expressing my gratitude for your unwavering support of my re-election campaign.**_
As Election Day nears, I'm taking some time to think back over the events that unfolded during my first term as Governor.
Do you remember Biden's Democrat allies in the legacy media running to cover for Dr. Fauci by supporting unscientific lockdowns and the harmful masking of our children?
Or the Biden administration blatantly and disgracefully colluding with Big Tech to silence free speech and cancel all dissent during the pandemic?
_Fortunately, they were not the only ones with access to COVID data ..._
As Governor of Florida, I reached out to and spoke with some of the best scientists and doctors in the world at Harvard, Stanford, and Oxford to assess the necessity of the Left's destructive lockdown policies.
**The data showed the Left 's draconian policies were failures, and I kept Florida open. And I'm glad I did.**
**Every American has a right to work.**

I know that we deserve better, and that we can do better.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48362889/357944395/1144435635?refcode=nw_em_templateheader&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5OTE3ZjBmMy0zYzBkLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=aTP-ztmusmmGFjQAo8awonhwkt98PoV2yATgihWSCOQ=)

Team,
In just a few days, we’re facing an urgent deadline in the race to defeat Mike DeWine – **[and we’ve set a goal of raising $20,000 online before midnight on Sunday. I hope you can chip in right now – here’s why.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48362890/357944396/1508168554?refcode=nw_em_220726_2_t2&amount=5&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&firstname=&lastname=&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5OTE3ZjBmMy0zYzBkLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=aTP-ztmusmmGFjQAo8awonhwkt98PoV2yATgihWSCOQ=)**
Mike DeWine has made no secret of the fact that he’s ready to pour everything he has into this race in an effort to hold on to the governorship.
It’s why he’s spent the past _decades_ in office cozying up to his special interest backers. He knows he can’t win on his record – not when that record includes pushing to completely ban abortion in Ohio, overseeing one of the largest corruption scandals in Ohio history, and putting guns into our schools rather than taking meaningful action to end gun violence.
**I know that we deserve better, and that we can do better.** Ohio has a proud history of innovation and progress, and of being a state where people come for opportunity and prosperity. Right now, we’re falling short thanks to Republican inaction and neglect – not to mention policies blatantly favoring the wealthy and well-connected. But we can become that state again.
**My team has set this goal of raising $20,000 online before July 31 because that’s what we need to do to combat Mike DeWine’s millions and be ready for the right-wing attacks we know are coming. **
**[That’s why today I’m asking: Will you rush $5 to my campaign before Sunday’s deadline to help us take on Mike DeWine and create a better future for Ohio?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48362891/357944397/1508168554?refcode=nw_em_220726_2_t2&amount=5&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&firstname=&lastname=&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5OTE3ZjBmMy0zYzBkLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=aTP-ztmusmmGFjQAo8awonhwkt98PoV2yATgihWSCOQ=)**
Together, I know we can do it.
Onward,
Nan Whaley
